TL;DR: JaxAHT：首个基于JAX的开源AHT库，加速并标准化AHT研究流程，速度提升约95倍，并附带多样化评估队友套件与大规模基准研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AHT研究受限于计算成本高昂、缺乏标准化基准实现，以及缺少多样且经验证的评估队友套件，阻碍了领域进展。

Method: 基于JAX的硬件加速与大规模并行能力，构建统一框架，支持队友生成、自我智能体训练及对未见队友的评估；并提供涵盖Level-Based Foraging、Overcooked、Hanabi的评估队友套件。

Result: 相较PyTorch实现获得约95倍墙钟时间加速；通过大规模计算受控基准研究比较队友生成与AHT智能体学习方法，发现没有算法始终最优，智能体建模的收益主要体现在角色化且队友多样的场景。

Conclusion: JaxAHT为AHT研究提供了加速与标准化的工具及评估资源，并通过基准研究揭示了现有方法的局限性与适用条件。

Abstract: Ad Hoc Teamwork (AHT) addresses the challenge of designing agents capable of coordinating with novel partners without prior coordination. However, progress in the field is hindered by the prohibitive computational cost of the AHT research lifecycle, the lack of standardized benchmark implementations, and the absence of a diverse, validated evaluation teammate suite. In this work, we introduce JaxAHT, the first open-source, JAX-based library designed to accelerate and standardize the AHT research lifecycle. Leveraging JAX's hardware acceleration and massive parallelization capabilities, JaxAHT provides a unified framework for teammate generation, ego agent training, and evaluation against unseen teammates, achieving approximately 95x wall-clock speedup over PyTorch counterparts. Alongside the library, we contribute a diverse suite of evaluation teammates across the domains of Level-Based Foraging, Overcooked, and Hanabi. To illustrate the value of the framework, we use it to conduct a large-scale, compute-controlled benchmark study comparing teammate generation and AHT agent learning methods, finding that no algorithm consistently performs best, and that agent modeling primarily offers benefits in role-based scenarios with diverse teammates.

</details>


### [372] [MANAS-2: Constrained Reconstruction for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13717)
*Arvasu Kulkarni,Aditya Ray Mishra,Mahir Jain,Parshva Runwal,Lakshya Saini,Siddharth Panwar,Sandeep Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EEG基础模型MANAS-2，将Raw-Band Hybrid掩码自编码器与物理启发的ConRec正则化结合，通过约束重构质量来塑造更具频谱组织性和可迁移性的潜表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码重构广泛用于EEG基础模型，但在低信噪比波形上优化重构并不一定产生最有用的潜表示，因此需要新的机制来塑造表示质量。

Method: MANAS-2 = Raw-Band Hybrid (RBH) 掩码自编码器 + Constrained Reconstruction (ConRec)。RBH联合重构时序波形patch和紧凑频谱带目标；ConRec仅作用于时序解码器输出，惩罚重构波形相邻短窗RMS能量的差异，使编码器偏向组织振荡包络信息。

Result: 在7个held-out EEG数据集上，加入ConRec使冻结ridge回归的六频带频谱功率恢复从R^2=0.860提升到0.906，patch间频带能量动态恢复从0.283提升到0.354，且时序波形信息仍高度可恢复。用于纯时序掩码自编码器时，即使无频谱目标也改善了冻结下游迁移和频率相关的潜几何，说明效果与架构无关。MANAS-2在多数下游知识迁移任务上优于领先EEG基础模型。

Conclusion: 通过解码器施加物理动机约束可得到频谱组织更好、更可迁移的潜空间。MANAS-2提供了以约束重构来塑造表示质量的新型EEG基础模型。

Abstract: Masked reconstruction is widely used for EEG foundation models, but optimizing reconstruction on low-SNR waveforms does not necessarily produce the most useful latent representation. We introduce MANAS-2, a new EEG foundation model that combines a Raw-Band Hybrid (RBH) masked autoencoder with Constrained Reconstruction (ConRec), a physics-motivated regularizer. RBH jointly reconstructs temporal waveform patches and compact spectral-band targets, while ConRec acts only on the temporal decoder output, penalizing differences in RMS energy between adjacent short windows of the reconstructed waveform. ConRec is intended to shape the encoder by biasing it toward the organization of oscillatory-envelope information. Across seven held-out EEG datasets, adding ConRec to an otherwise identical RBH model increases frozen ridge recovery of six-band spectral power from mean R^2=0.860 to 0.906 and recovery of inter-patch band-energy dynamics from R^2=0.283 to 0.354, while temporal waveform information remains highly recoverable from the frozen latents. Applied to a temporal-only masked autoencoder, ConRec also improves frozen downstream transfer and frequency-dependent latent geometry despite receiving no spectral targets: i.e., the effects of ConRec are architecture-independent. MANAS-2 also outperforms leading EEG Foundation Models on most downstream knowledge-transfer tasks. From the effects of ConRec, we see that a physically motivated constraint imposed through the decoder can make for a more spectrally organized and transferable latent space. MANAS-2 therefore provides a new EEG foundation model built around constrained reconstruction as a mechanism for shaping representation--rather than reconstruction--quality.

</details>


### [373] [IBBench-Light: A Paired Evaluation of Task-Conditioned Responses to External Directives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13725)
*Kainan Zhou,Gangzhen Qian,Zhaoyi Li,Hang Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IBBench-Light提出配对精确契约准确度(PECA),用同一记录的两种用途(执行/处理)测评指令模型,揭示边际平均会掩盖成对失败,且EOS停止策略会剧烈改变结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部记录可能依据用户请求包含待执行过程或待阅读文本;现有评测多用边际平均,会掩盖同一记录两种用途下的成对一致性失败,且停止策略等生成设置的影响未被充分审计。

Method: IBBench-Light对同一记录测试两种用途,12个语义基产生每模型144对(4个量化指令模型共1,152条归档贪婪响应)。PECA要求成对两者都满足输出契约。另做字面目标暴露与大小写归一化审计,追加1,722条CPU生成以测试无指令对照、12个新语义基、基内措辞变化与生成停止;并用固定SmolLM2检查点做有界IHEval比较。

Result: Qwen在132个执行与109个处理提示上成功,但仅97对完整通过,说明边际平均遗漏的信息。在固定的Phi重跑中,仅改变EOS集合就使精确配对成功从0/144变为62/144。

Conclusion: 该基准衡量条件性任务与输出契约成功;其任务边际与配对计数必须结合停止策略一起解读。

Abstract: An external record may contain a procedure to apply or text to read, depending on the user's request. IBBench-Light tests both uses against the same record. Twelve semantic bases yield 144 matched pairs per model; four quantized instruction models produced 1,152 archived greedy responses. Paired exact-contract accuracy (PECA) requires both members to satisfy their output contracts. Qwen succeeds on 132 execute and 109 process prompts, but only 97 complete pairs, showing what marginal averages omit. We audit literal-target exposure and case normalization, then add 1,722 logged CPU generations to test directive-absent controls, twelve additional semantic bases, within-base wording changes, and generation stopping. In the pinned Phi rerun, changing the end-of-sequence (EOS) set changes exact paired success from 0/144 to 62/144. A bounded IHEval comparison uses the same SmolLM2 checkpoint and output budget while preserving its published instruction roles and scorer. The benchmark measures conditional task and output-contract success. Its task margins and paired count need to be read together with the stopping policy.

</details>


### [374] [Trustworthy Agentic AI: A Comprehensive Cybersecurity and Systems Survey on Threat Landscapes, Defense Architectures, and Open Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13731)
*Seyedakbar Mostafavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本综述为可信自主AI智能体提供系统安全参考框架，综合206项研究与监管标准，形式化智能体架构与可信度分类学，分析威胁面并构建多层零信任防御架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从被动基础模型向自主目标导向的智能体AI转变，带来递归推理、持久记忆、实时工具执行与多智能体协作等能力，但也使自然语言同时充当输入、控制代码与通信协议，导致传统安全边界瓦解，形成图灵完备的攻击面，非可信数据即成为可执行指令。

Method: 综合206项基础研究与监管标准；将通用智能体架构形式化为有状态5元组；建立覆盖安全、安保、隐私、可解释性、公平性、问责性的6维可信度分类学；系统分析执行循环内部与交互平面的威胁面；提出整合Dual-LLM隔离、能力访问控制、内核eBPF探针与沙箱运行时的多层零信任纵深防御架构；复评标准化评测基准并将技术控制映射至国际AI治理框架。

Result: 提出系统的威胁面分析与多层零信任防御纵深架构，并完成评测基准梳理与治理框架映射。

Conclusion: 该综述为可信自主AI智能体的系统安全提供了综合性参考框架，连接技术与治理，支撑安全智能体系统的设计与评估。

Abstract: The transition from passive foundation models to autonomous, goal-directed agentic AI systems has introduced unprecedented capabilities by coupling recursive cognitive reasoning loops, persistent memory architectures, live tool execution planes, and multi-agent collaboration topologies. However, granting probabilistic neural cores execution authority across filesystems, networks, and cloud infrastructure dissolves classical security perimeters: natural language simultaneously serves as input data, internal control code, and communication protocols, exposing a Turing-complete blast radius where untrusted data represents executable instructions. This survey delivers a comprehensive systems-security reference framework for trustworthy agentic AI, synthesizing 206 foundational studies and regulatory standards. We formalize the general agent architecture as a stateful 5-tuple and establish a 6-dimensional trustworthiness taxonomy covering security, safety, privacy, explainability, fairness, and accountability. We systematically analyze threat surfaces across intra-execution loops and interaction planes, formulate a multi-layered zero-trust defense-in-depth architecture integrating Dual-LLM isolation, Capability-Based Access Control, kernel eBPF probes, and sandboxed runtimes, review standardized evaluation benchmarks, and map technical controls to international AI governance frameworks.

</details>


### [375] [How Many Thoughts Can a Vector Hold? The Capacity of Reasoning by Superposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13747)
*Hongyu Gu,Chang Liu,Jingwen Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 连续思维中的潜在状态不应只保留当前推理前沿，而应累积叠加完整推理历史；均匀累积权重在固定表示预算下可实现更可靠、可复用的推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统思维链将中间计算编码为token，而近期连续/循环方法把部分计算放入固定维度潜在状态，使单个“思维”可叠加多种备选。这引出核心设计问题：连续思维在推理推进时应保留什么？直觉认为丢弃过去计算、仅保留当前前沿更好，否则会稀释状态、浪费容量。论文旨在检验并纠正这一直觉。

Method: 在相同下游计算条件下，比较两类加权叠加：仅保留当前备选的“前沿叠加”与保留完整推理历史的“累积叠加”。分析所需表示维度，并研究潜在状态中记忆的加权方式；进一步证明均匀累积权重在未知未来使用下的 minimax 最优性。

Result: 累积叠加保留完整推理历史所需表示维度可低于仅保留当前备选的前沿叠加。在固定隐藏宽度下，该优势使潜在推理器保留更多有效证据、区分更多下游结果，并延迟压缩状态失效点。原因在于有信息的历史成分会连贯增强，而不相关备选带来随机干扰。优先近期或显著项会导致记忆表示过弱并瓶颈后续注意力。

Conclusion: 应放弃仅保留推理前沿的直觉，将叠加视为设计原则：均匀累积记忆使固定表示预算支持更可靠、可复用的计算。

Abstract: Large language models solve hard problems through intermediate computations across multi-step reasoning. Traditional chain-of-thought encodes these computations as tokens. Recent continuous and recurrent methods instead move partial computations into fixed-dimensional latent states, where a single thought can superpose multiple alternatives. This raises a fundamental design question:what should continuous thoughts preserve as reasoning proceeds? An intuitive approach discards past computations and keeps only the current reasoning frontier. Storing more items seems to dilute states and waste limited representational capacity. We show this intuition can be incorrect. Under identical downstream computations, cumulative superposition retaining full reasoning history can require lower representational dimensions than frontier-only superposition holding only current alternatives. At fixed hidden width, this advantage allows latent reasoners to retain more valid evidence, distinguish more plausible downstream outcomes, and delay the point where compressed states turn unreliable. This counter-intuitive effect emerges because informative historical components coherently reinforce each other, while unrelated alternatives bring random interference. This perspective also answers a practical design question: how should models weight memories accumulated inside latent states when their future use is unknown? Across reusable weighted superpositions, prioritizing a small set of recent or salient items produces weakly-represented memories that bottleneck subsequent attention. Uniform cumulative weighting avoids this flaw, and we prove it is minimax-optimal for robust future reasoning. Our results turn superposition from an observed latent-space effect into a design principle: balanced cumulative memory lets a fixed representational budget support more reliable, reusable computations.

</details>


### [376] [Positioning manuscripts in the scientific landscape with agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13760)
*Jiawen Chen,Zichen Zhang,Bingxuan Li,Quan Sun,Yiyan Zhang,Edric Tam,Jinjie Lin,Didong Li,Yun Li,Bingxin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PASS智能体系统，通过理解稿件的领域文献语境预测其最匹配的发表期刊，Top-1准确率50.3%、Top-5达86.1%，超越现有LLM基线与期刊选择工具，并已公开上线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发表论文过程耗时、压力大且结果不确定，希望利用LLM智能体帮助研究者判断稿件最匹配的发表期刊。

Method: PASS通过重建稿件局部科学邻域、追踪主题轨迹、在领域期刊空间中推理，将稿件定位于其文献语境，从而预测顶级匹配期刊；含关键文献检索模块。

Result: 在超2000篇预印本、16个生物医学领域的防泄漏基准上，Top-1 50.3%、Top-5 86.1%，超过SOTA LLM基线与传统工具；文献检索模块贡献最大；仅用摘要即可接近全性能，而基线需全文；质量评分与独立发表结果一致；人工评估认可度高。

Conclusion: PASS证明智能体AI可可靠辅助期刊选择，文献检索是关键，且对短文本输入高效，已作为公共平台发布供研究者使用。

Abstract: Publishing a research manuscript is a routine yet demanding part of scientific life: time-consuming, stressful, and often uncertain in outcome. Recent advances in large language model (LLM)-based agentic AI have shown promise across a range of scientific tasks, and here we ask whether agentic AI can help researchers navigate the publication process itself by reliably inferring a manuscript's eventual publication venue from its content and literature context. We introduce PASS (Publication-oriented Agentic Scientific System), an agentic system that understands manuscripts within their domain-specific literature context and predicts top-matched publication venues. PASS positions each manuscript within its surrounding literature landscape by reconstructing its local scientific neighborhood, tracing its topic trajectory, and reasoning over field-specific journal spaces. Evaluated on a leakage-audited benchmark of over 2,000 preprints across 16 biomedical fields, PASS achieved Top-1 accuracy of 50.3% and Top-5 accuracy of 86.1%, outperforming state-of-the-art LLM baselines and established journal-selection tools. PASS-produced quality scores, such as impact potential and novelty, aligned with independent measures of publication outcome. We also found that the designed literature retrieval module is the strongest performance contributor, particularly for positioning manuscripts relative to nearby work, and that PASS maintained near-full performance from the abstract alone, whereas LLM baselines required the full manuscript text. An independent human evaluation found strong researcher agreement with PASS's manuscript understanding and recommendation rationale. PASS has been released as a public platform (https://ratemypaper.ai/) for broad researcher access.

</details>


### [377] [Homeostatic Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13771)
*Yue Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"稳态持续学习"（Homeostatic Continual Learning）方法，使AI智能体在变化环境中持续学习而不发生灾难性遗忘，并探讨其用于构建世界模型的可能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体需在动态变化环境中持续学习，但面临灾难性遗忘问题，需在保留旧知识的同时获取新能力。

Method: 当智能体输出出现异常时，通过检测环境数据中的离群点来定位新情况；借此逐步完善模型与策略，扩展其适用的上下文范围。同时提出将世界中的物体分解为特征、抽象为可比的概念实例、并经由特征将概念映射到意图，以构建世界模型。

Result: 智能体能够逐步完善模型与策略，并越来越多地适应不断扩展的上下文情境（论文未给出量化实验结果）。

Conclusion: 论文讨论了使该方法落地所需的后续工作、其与人工智能多个领域的联系及更广泛的意义，属于理论构想与展望性研究。

Abstract: In this paper, I formulate a Continual Learning problem and propose a method named "Homeostatic Continual Learning" that enables an AI agent to learn continuously in a changing environment without catastrophic forgetting. The core of the method is to find outliers in the environment data when the agent experiences an outlier in its output. Through this method, the agent gradually completes its model and policy and performs well in more and more contexts. I also suggest that we may use the method to build a world model where the agent factorizes the objects in the world into features, abstract objects into comparable instances of concepts and map concepts to intents through features. I discuss the works needed to render the method practical, the connections to many fields in Artificial Intelligence and the broader implications of the method.

</details>


### [378] [Surprising Effectiveness of Self-Demonstrations in Enhancing Schema-Ontology Mapping with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13776)
*Siddhesh Thombre,Manasi Patwardhan,Sunita Sarawagi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自演示驱动的神经符号方法，通过级联子任务分解与模式引导、依赖感知的自生成演示，解决关系数据库到本体映射的语义异构问题，在RODI基准上F1提升25个百分点，达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业知识表示中，将异构关系数据库整合到集中式本体面临语义异构、模式命名晦涩、元数据缺失以及关系模式与本体模型间抽象鸿沟等挑战。虽然LLM具备强语义推理能力，但直接采用一次性提示或朴素多阶段流水线在模式-本体映射上表现不佳。

Method: 提出自演示驱动方法，结合神经符号任务分解与自动生成模式引导、依赖感知演示的机制。两大策略：(i) 将任务神经符号分解为级联子任务，用符号约束结构化搜索空间，LLM在各聚焦子任务内进行语义推理；(ii) 用领域无关模式引导自生成演示，为每个子任务提供监督。

Result: 在RODI基准中三个最具挑战性的场景上实验，方法达到SOTA性能，相比传统模式到本体映射技术及近期基于LLM的模式到本体与模式匹配方法，F1提升约25个百分点。消融研究揭示模式引导自演示与神经符号任务分解各有显著且互补的收益。

Conclusion: 神经符号分解与模式引导自演示相结合可显著提升LLM在模式-本体映射中的准确性，验证了两种策略的必要性与互补性，为企业异构数据库本体整合提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Integrating heterogeneous relational databases into a centralized ontology remains a persistent challenge in enterprise knowledge representation, primarily due to semantic heterogeneity, cryptic schema naming, missing metadata, and the abstraction gap between relational schemas and ontological models. Although large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic reasoning capabilities, we show that directly applying them through one-shot prompting or naive multi-stage pipelines leads to poor performance for schema-ontology mapping. This paper presents a self-demonstration-driven approach that combines a neuro-symbolic task decomposition with a novel mechanism for automatically generating pattern-guided, dependency-aware demonstrations to address this integration challenge. Our approach incorporates two key strategies to achieve substantial accuracy gains over existing LLM-based schema integration methods: (i) a neuro-symbolic decomposition of the task into cascaded sub-tasks, where symbolic constraints structure the search space and LLMs perform semantic reasoning within each focused sub-task, and (ii) self-generated demonstrations guided by domain-agnostic patterns to supervise each sub-task. Experiments on three of the most challenging scenarios from the RODI benchmark show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially outperforming (25 percentage points F1 improvements) both traditional schema-to-ontology mapping techniques and recent LLM-based schema-to-ontology and schema matching approaches. Ablation studies further reveal the significant benefits of pattern-guided self-demonstrations and the complementary benefits of neuro-symbolic task decomposition.

</details>


### [379] [Partition Scores Are Not System Scores: Deployment-Fidelity Gaps in Decomposed Algorithm Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13785)
*Jiachen Zhang,Yu Tang,Li Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文定义"部署保真度差距"G(R),量化分解式算法选择中分区级oracle评分与可部署端到端效用的差异,并给出稳定性条件与识别区间,在5个基准上验证该差距普遍存在且可达0.13。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分区级(oracle式)分数常被当作可部署选择器性能的上界,但分解式流水线在固定家族选择器后必须用学习到的族内选择器替代族内oracle,导致报告分数与真实部署效用不一致,可能误判分解方案与扁平方案的优劣。

Method: 将G(R)定义为分区级与可部署端到端效用之差;推导逐实例的margin-regret稳定性条件(判断分区时家族选择是否部署最优)与仅用分区数据的sharp识别区间(区间严格跨零则分区报告无法认证部署赢家);并提出训练侧验证集上的gap-correction诊断。

Result: 在涵盖表格AutoML与CSP/SAT的5个公开基准中,所有分解式流水线G(R)>0(TabZilla 0.012至PROTEUS-2014 0.13);10个分解vs扁平决策中有4个点估计符号翻转,PROTEUS-2014上33个百分点的分区优势缩至20个百分点的端到端优势;gap-correction诊断在4个符号翻转单元上全部恢复正确符号。

Conclusion: 分区级报告会系统性高估分解式流水线,应同时报告分区与端到端分数;gap-correction诊断是报告辅助手段,不能替代直接端到端评估。

Abstract: Oracle-style quantities, including virtual best solvers, selected-portfolio VBS, virtual-best encodings, and best-in-family summaries, are widely reported as upper bounds on what a deployable selector could achieve. In decomposed algorithm selection, an analogous partition-level score grants an oracle choice of the best algorithm within the selected family; once the family selector is fixed, the deployable system must replace that within-family oracle with a learned within-family selector.
  We define the deployment-fidelity gap G(R) as the difference between partition-level and deployable end-to-end utility and derive two accounting consequences: a per-instance margin-regret stability condition that tells us when a partition-time family choice is deployment-optimal, and a sharp partition-only identification interval that, when it strictly crosses zero, prevents the partition-level report from certifying the deployable winner.
  Across five public algorithm-selection benchmarks spanning tabular AutoML and combinatorial CSP/SAT, every decomposed pipeline has positive G(R), ranging from 0.012 on TabZilla to 0.13 on PROTEUS-2014. Four of ten decomposed-versus-flat decisions have sign-changing point estimates; on PROTEUS-2014, a 33-point partition advantage shrinks to a 20-point end-to-end advantage. A training-side validation gap-correction diagnostic recovers the point-estimate deployable sign on all four sign-changing cells; it is a reporting aid, not a substitute for direct end-to-end evaluation. Partition and end-to-end scores should be reported side by side.

</details>


### [380] [Do Not Restart: Residual Completion for Stateful Agent Handoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13800)
*Runzhi Deng,Yiming Zhong,Fang Zhao,Pan Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出承诺前沿残差补全CFRC，将跨模型状态化交接形式化为承诺约束下的残差补全问题，通过冻结残差契约、构建证据链接图、以实时收据解除义务，在保持精度同时大幅降低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路由与级联可跨模型转移控制以降低工具代理成本，但有状态交接必须保留已接受的选择、已实现的效果和未完成的义务，否则难以保证正确性。

Method: 形式化为承诺约束的残差补全，提出CFRC：强制"目标先于提议、整体提议先于授权、实时证据先于成功"；从已接受进展中冻结残差契约，将后继延续闭包为证据链接图，仅当剩余被覆盖时才允许执行，并用实时收据解除义务。

Result: 在五个环境和两组同源模型对中，CFRC达到与强全任务代理相当的整体准确率，推理成本仅为其22.0%–34.6%；跨提供商结果进一步展示更广迁移能力。

Conclusion: CFRC证明了契约相对部分正确性，并在完整契约构造下可扩展至原始残差请求，为低成本、可验证的跨模型工具代理交接提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Routing and cascades reduce tool-agent cost by transferring control across models, but stateful handoffs must preserve accepted choices, realized effects, and unfinished obligations. We formulate this as commitment-constrained residual completion and introduce Commitment-Frontier Residual Completion (CFRC). CFRC enforces target-before-proposal, whole-proposal-before-authority, and live-evidence-before-success: it freezes a residual contract from accepted progress, closes the successor continuation into an evidence-linked graph, and admits execution only when the remainder is covered, with live receipts discharging obligations. We establish contract-relative partial correctness, which extends to the original residual request under complete contract construction. Across five environments and two same-provider model pairs, CFRC achieves comparable macro accuracy to strong full-task agents at only 22.0%-34.6% of their inference cost, with additional cross-provider results demonstrating broader transfer.

</details>


### [381] [LLM-Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Unified Electric Vehicles-Charging Station-Grid Optimization in Public Charging Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13805)
*Yang Zhang,Lindong Xie,Chongyu Wang,Gaojunjie Li,Siqi Bu,Edward Chung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM增强的MARL框架，首次在统一闭环中同时优化电网、电动汽车和充电站，利用LLM进行可解释特征选择与自适应多目标平衡，市场效率优于基线且训练时间减少70%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT时代下，协调电动汽车充电调度需兼顾充电满意度、站点盈利与电网稳定，构成复杂多目标难题。现有MARL方法难以应对海量IoT感知数据带来的高维状态空间及利益相关方的目标冲突。

Method: 提出LLM增强的MARL框架，首次将电网、电动汽车、充电站纳入统一闭环优化。通过引入LLM解决两大瓶颈：一是分析实时IoT环境状态，提取具有物理意义的可解释特征；二是以语义推理动态分配利润、用户满意度、电网负载等冲突目标的权重，替代复杂的人工调参。

Result: 大量实验表明，该框架显著优于最先进基线，实现更高的市场效率，同时将训练时间缩短70%以上。

Conclusion: 该方法为高效、可持续的IoT城市充电基础设施管理提供了可扩展、透明且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: In the era of the Internet of Things (IoT), coordinating connected electric vehicle (EV) charging scheduling to balance EV charging satisfaction, station profitability, and smart grid stability presents a complex multi-objective challenge. Existing Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) approaches often struggle with high-dimensional state spaces generated by massive IoT sensing data and conflicting stakeholder interests. This paper proposes a novel LLM-enhanced MARL framework that, for the first time, simultaneously optimizes the Grid, EVs, and Stations within a unified loop. By integrating Large Language Model (LLM), we address two critical bottlenecks: interpretable feature selection and adaptive multi-objective balancing. The LLM analyzes real-time IoT-collected environmental states to extract physically significant features and dynamically assigns weights to conflicting objectives-including profit, user satisfaction, and grid load-using semantic reasoning instead of complex manual tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving superior market efficiency while reducing training time by over 70%. This approach offers a scalable, transparent solution for efficient and sustainable IoT-enabled urban charging infrastructure management.

</details>


### [382] [Bypass Observation: A Conceptual Design of a Non-Intrusive Layer-Wise Semantic Extraction Architecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13807)
*Haibin Tong,Jiang Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"Bypass Observation"：在Transformer选定层附加只读观测头，实现逐层可观测性，并给出开销分析，但仅为概念性方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在高维隐空间推理，用户只能看到最终输出，中间计算过程不可见，缺乏透明度与可观测性。

Method: 在选定Transformer层附加只读观测头，不回馈到主干网络，非侵入式。三种变体：共享LM head、层专属head、层/步自适应head；支持稀疏观测、低秩分解、缩小词表、top-k读读、选择性位置等降本手段。

Result: 推导全词表读出的闭式开销近似，主要受V/(12d)支配，典型估计约30%–240%；并区分bypass CoT与常规CoT（后者进入自回归计算，前者推理时因果外部，但可用于RL训练信号）。

Conclusion: Bypass Observation可提升模型计算可观测性，但仅是隐状态的部分、可能误导的投影；对循环/递归深度Transformer，逐迭代读出或可揭示收敛、振荡与停机信号。本工作为概念与分析性，系统实证验证尚待开展。

Abstract: Large language models reason in high-dimensional hidden-state spaces, while users observe only final outputs. We introduce Bypass Observation, a non-intrusive layer-wise readout architecture that attaches read-only observation heads to selected Transformer layers without feeding their outputs back into the backbone. We consider three variants: a shared LM head across layers, layer-specific heads, and a layer- or step-adaptive head. For full-vocabulary readout, we derive a closed-form overhead approximation governed primarily by V/(12d), with representative estimates ranging from about 30% to 240%, and discuss cost reductions via sparse observation, low-rank factorization, reduced vocabularies, top-k readout, and selective positions. We argue that Bypass Observation can make model computation more observable while remaining only a partial, potentially misleading projection of hidden states. We further distinguish bypass chain-of-thought from conventional chain-of-thought: conventional reasoning tokens enter the autoregressive computation, whereas bypass readouts remain causally external at inference time, although they can still provide training signals in reinforcement learning. Finally, we discuss applications to looped and recurrent-depth Transformers, where iteration-wise readout may expose convergence, oscillation, and potential halting signals. The proposal is conceptual and analytical; systematic empirical validation remains future work.

</details>


### [383] [ViperQ: Order Flow Pattern Recognition via Auction Market Theory for Reinforcement Learning Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13825)
*Asser Moustafa,Rares-Mihail Neagu,Jugal Kalita*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ViperQ将拍卖市场理论（AMT）的微观结构特征（VPOC、价值区域、低成交量节点、CVD背离、成交速度）构建为20维状态向量，用PPO与前景理论非对称奖励训练，在TSLA/NVDA未见数据上分别取得+163.6%和+116.5% ROI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学术RL交易系统几乎只用OHLCV或订单簿深度特征，而实务界的拍卖市场理论与市场轮廓理论缺少同行评审的计算实现，本文填补这一空白。

Method: 以AMT原语构建20维Z标准化状态表示；使用两个PPO智能体；设计基于前景理论的非对称奖励函数，按Kahneman与Tversky的损失厌恶系数惩罚持仓亏损。

Result: 在未见过12个月机构tick数据上：TSLA +163.6% ROI（最大回撤-27.5%，27,019笔），NVDA +116.5% ROI（最大回撤-47.8%，12,892笔），零杠杆。

Conclusion: 结果证明AMT特征可作为金融时序上序贯决策的可训练结构化输入模态，并推动微观结构感知的策略学习研究。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning trading systems published in the academic literature overwhelmingly rely on price-aggregate state representations (OHLCV bars) or limit-order-book depth features, leaving microstructure pattern theories from the practitioner literature, namely Auction Market Theory and Market Profile, without a peer-reviewed computational instantiation. We present ViperQ, a reinforcement learning system whose state representation is built explicitly from Auction Market Theory primitives: Volume Point of Control, Value Area position, Low Volume Node flags, Cumulative Volume Delta divergence, and tape-velocity signatures, assembled into a 20-dimensional Z-normalised vector. Two Proximal Policy Optimisation agents are trained with a prospect theory-grounded asymmetric reward function that penalises losing holds at a magnitude consistent with Kahneman and Tversky's loss-aversion coefficient. Evaluated on a held-out twelve-month partition of institutional tick data the agents have never seen, ViperQ achieves +163.6% ROI on TSLA (-27.5% max drawdown, 27,019 trades) and +116.5% ROI on NVDA (-47.8% max drawdown, 12,892 trades) under zero leverage. The results establish Auction Market Theory features as a tractable structured input modality for sequential decision-making on financial time series and motivate further work on microstructure-aware policy learning.

</details>


### [384] [UniCAR-RL: Seeing Better before Thinking Deeper in Visual Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13849)
*Yuzhe Li,Hao Yan,Hao Wang,Xingchen Liu,Ya-Qi Yu,Jihao Wu,Minghui Liao,Wei Chen,Yuliang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出UniCAR-RL，一个无需标注的强化学习框架，通过解耦感知与推理优化来提升MLLM的数学视觉推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在复杂数学视觉推理中因缺乏细粒度感知而产生初始视觉幻觉，进而触发级联推理失败。传统端到端RL的稀疏奖励无法解耦感知幻觉与逻辑错误，难以针对性优化感知；而用感知增强CoT数据微调则成本高且带来幻觉。

Method: UniCAR-RL在训练中显式解耦感知与推理优化，包含三个协同分支：1) Caption-RL分支，通过验证器引导的推理验证优化感知能力；2) Reasoning-RL分支，基于金标准图像描述进行逻辑推理以阻断级联错误；3) QA-RL分支，保留原生端到端对齐以保障问答性能。

Result: 实验表明，仅使用原始短答案数据，UniCAR-RL即可显著提升MLLM的数学与视觉推理能力，并在多种架构和规模上展现出强泛化性。

Conclusion: 通过无标注RL显式解耦感知与推理优化，UniCAR-RL有效缓解级联幻觉，为提升MLLM复杂视觉推理提供了高效且可泛化的方案。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with complex mathematical visual reasoning primarily due to a lack of fine-grained perception, causing initial visual hallucinations to directly trigger cascading reasoning failures. In traditional end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL), sparse rewards fail to decouple perceptual hallucinations from logical missteps, hindering targeted perception optimization. Alternatively, fine-tuning with perception-enhanced CoT data incurs high costs and hallucinations. In this paper, we address these challenges by proposing UniCAR-RL, an annotation-free RL framework. By explicitly decoupling the optimization of perception and reasoning during the training process, it achieves isolation and optimization of both capabilities. Specifically, UniCAR-RL consists of three synergistic branches: 1) a Caption-RL branch that optimizes perception capabilities through verifier-guided reasoning validation; 2) a Reasoning-RL branch that performs logical reasoning based on a gold image description to halt cascading errors; 3) a QA-RL branch that retains native end-to-end alignment to ensure robust question-answering performance. Experiments show that UniCAR-RL substantially improves MLLMs' mathematical and visual reasoning using only raw short-answer data. Furthermore, it demonstrates strong generalization across diverse architectures and scales.

</details>


### [385] [ClinAgent: A ReAct-Based Agent for Conversational Access to Clinical Trial Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13860)
*Antonino Vaccarella,Riccardo Cantini,Domenico Talia,Paolo Trunfio,Marianna Talia,Rosamaria Lappano,Marcello Maggiolini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ClinAgent，基于agentic RAG的对话系统，支持自然语言查询临床试验信息并进行多源综合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询临床试验注册库仍依赖人工，流程易错，需处理大量半结构化数据，且缺乏自然语言交互和跨源综合能力。

Method: 以LLM agent为核心，采用ReAct范式，迭代推理、选择并调用工具；工具包括ClinicalTrials.gov检索、PubMed模块和基于本地缓存结构化数据的Python分析器。用三阶段框架评估操作有效性、规划质量、工具使用效率和专家定性判断，对比Gemini 3.0 Flash与DeepSeek V3.2（思考/非思考）三种后端。

Result: 三种模型各有优势：DeepSeek（思考模式）在规划质量上表现最佳，Gemini总体性能最高并获专家最高评价。

Conclusion: agentic AI系统可提升临床试验信息的可获取性与综合能力，支持更高效、以用户为中心的研究工作流。

Abstract: Querying clinical trial registries remains a manual and error-prone process, requiring researchers to navigate large volumes of semi-structured data without support for natural language interaction or cross-source synthesis. To address this, we introduce ClinAgent, a conversational system based on agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) that enables clinicians and researchers to query clinical trial information in plain language and receive grounded, up-to-date responses across multi-turn interactions. The system centers on a Large Language Model (LLM) agent following the ReAct paradigm, which iteratively reasons over queries, selects among a set of integrated tools, and refines its actions based on intermediate outputs. These tools include a ClinicalTrials.gov search interface, a PubMed module, and a Python-based analyzer operating on a locally cached structured dataset of clinical trials. We evaluate the system using a three-phase framework assessing operational effectiveness, planning quality, tool-use efficiency, and expert qualitative judgments, comparing three LLM backends: Gemini 3.0 Flash and two variants of DeepSeek V3.2 (thinking and non-thinking). Results reveal complementary strengths, with DeepSeek (thinking mode) excelling in planning quality, while Gemini achieves the highest overall performance and strongest expert ratings. Overall, our findings highlight the potential of agentic AI systems to improve the accessibility and synthesis of clinical trial information, supporting more efficient and user-centered biomedical research workflows.

</details>


### [386] [Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13879)
*Yiling Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个五部分归因表框架，用于区分表征获取中的不同认知能力承诺，并将其应用于Othello-GPT等案例，说明认知成就的归因范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已获取的表征可扩展系统认知库，却不必然转移产生该表征所运用的能力；需要明确这种扩展及其局限的规范框架。

Method: 提出五部分归因表：有效追踪、已获结构的应用、从明确规范中获取、从识别性观察中获取、保持与重用；每项标明正面能力承诺及需额外支持的主张。辅以地图与类别示例，并附简短形式证明。

Result: 即使具备完整的应用能力，获取能力仍不确定；从描述中获得标准不同于从实例中发现标准。框架应用于Othello-GPT的世界模型解读及当代机器概念指标。

Conclusion: 结论关乎认知归因的范围而非概念拥有的构成条件：认知成就应就其确立的能力获得承认，而不应通过标签暗中引入更广的能力库。

Abstract: An acquired representation can enlarge a system's cognitive repertoire without transferring the capacities exercised in producing that representation. This paper develops a framework for specifying that enlargement and its limits. Its central contribution is a five-part attribution table distinguishing effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse. Each entry identifies a positive capacity commitment and a further claim requiring additional support. The argument deliberately grants meaningful content, causal efficacy, and productive inference, so that its conclusion does not depend on treating representations as inert encodings. Map and category examples show why even complete application competence leaves acquisition capacity undetermined, and why acquiring a criterion from its description differs from finding it in examples. Short formal proofs appear in an appendix. The framework is applied to Andrew Ng's world-model interpretation of Othello-GPT and to the specific indicators discussed in contemporary accounts of machine concepts. It preserves demonstrated recognition, classification, inference, and qualified acquisition while specifying what remains unestablished about criterion discovery and accumulation. The result concerns the scope of cognitive attribution rather than the constitutive conditions of concept possession: cognitive achievements deserve credit for the capacities they establish, without silently importing a broader repertoire through the labels attached to them.

</details>


### [387] [LoRA Fine-Tuned Models for Control Systems Course Q\&A: A Multidimensional Evaluation of Model Scale and Rank Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13918)
*Shaowen Lu,Chengxu Liu,Ping Zhou,Tao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究用360条控制系统课程对话数据对Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct进行LoRA微调，发现LoRA在文本相似度和结构化输出稳定性上均有提升，7B-r16效果最佳，但指标仅反映文本相似性而非推理正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用LLM在控制系统等专业课程中回答存在结构不一致、术语符号协调性差、难以验证的问题，需要让开源指令模型更贴近课程参考答案的语言和教学组织方式。

Method: 基于线性控制系统课程的习题与参考解答构建360条系统-用户-助手对话的监督微调数据集；对Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct应用LoRA（秩r=4/8/16），在相同数据划分、推理设置和评估协议下对比基座与微调模型。

Result: LoRA在两个模型规模上均提升了相似度和结构化输出稳定性。7B-r16取得最高ROUGE-L(0.4093)和BERTScore-F1(0.8643)，r=8在性能与参数效率间更平衡。Bootstrap重采样显示3B-r16的ROUGE-L增益0.0764[0.0613,0.0915]，7B-r16为0.0874[0.0687,0.1042]，置信区间均超过零。

Conclusion: LoRA可使开源指令微调模型更贴合课程参考答案的语言和教学组织。但现有指标主要捕捉文本相似度与格式一致性，无法反映领域推理与数学正确性，仍需专家评估和任务专用评分标准。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in specialized university courses, but control-systems questions require coordinated terminology, notation, derivations, and stepwise explanations. Direct general-purpose responses may be inconsistently structured and hard to verify. Using exercises and reference solutions from a Linear Control Systems course, we built a supervised fine-tuning dataset of 360 system-user-assistant conversations. We applied LoRA to Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. With identical data splits, inference settings, and evaluation protocols, we compared base and fine-tuned models and tested LoRA ranks r=4, 8, and 16. Evaluation used ROUGE, BERTScore, and structured-output features to measure reference-answer similarity and stability of the Solution-Method-Teaching Points format. LoRA improved both similarity and structured-output stability at both sizes. On the current test set, 7B-r16 achieved the highest ROUGE-L (0.4093) and BERTScore-F1 (0.8643), while r=8 offered a better balance between performance and parameter efficiency. Bootstrap resampling showed ROUGE-L gains of 0.0764 [0.0613, 0.0915] for 3B-r16 and 0.0874 [0.0687, 0.1042] for 7B-r16; both intervals exceeded zero, indicating stable textual-similarity improvements on the current test set. These results suggest LoRA can align open-source instruction-tuned models more closely with the language and pedagogical organization of course reference answers. However, the metrics mainly capture textual similarity and formatting consistency, not domain-specific reasoning or mathematical correctness, which require expert assessment and task-specific rubrics.

</details>


### [388] [SAILOR: Solver-Assisted Interactive LLM-based Optimization Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13945)
*Shaghayegh Sadeghi,Stephen L. Smith,David C. Del Rey Fern'andez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAILOR通过检测缺失数值、主动提问并更新优化模型，验证了在理想模拟反馈下主动澄清优化问题的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言描述的优化问题常缺少求解器所需的数值信息（成本、容量、需求、边界、惩罚等），语言模型生成代码时遇到缺失值只能停止或猜测。

Method: 提出SAILOR原型系统：检测不受支持的数值选择，向用户提出针对性后续问题，并在返回解前更新优化模型；利用不确定性和求解器估计的缺失值对当前模型的影响来优先排序问题。

Result: 在7个掩码基准的1723个实例上，用返回真值的理想化模拟器评估，目标值完全一致率为27.0%–87.6%，平均每题提问1.4–5.7个。

Conclusion: 结果证明了在受控分支-揭示反馈下该方法的可行性；但未衡量与真实用户交互的表现或一般的结构性模型修复能力。

Abstract: Natural-language descriptions of optimization problems may be incomplete or vague about numerical information that a solver requires, including costs, capacities, demands, bounds, and penalties. A language model can translate the description into code, but when a required value is absent it must either stop or guess. We present SAILOR, a proof-of-concept system that detects such unsupported numerical choices, asks the user targeted follow-up questions, and updates the optimization model before returning a solution. Questions are prioritized using uncertainty and solver-derived estimates of how strongly each missing value affects the current model. We evaluate the pipeline on 1,723 instances from seven masked benchmarks using an idealized simulator that returns ground-truth values. Exact objective-value agreement ranges from 27.0% to 87.6% across datasets, with 1.4--5.7 questions per instance on average. These results establish feasibility under controlled branch-and-reveal feedback; they do not measure performance with human users or general structural model repair. Code is available at: https://github.com/sshaghayeghs/SAILOR.

</details>


### [389] [Synthetic Data in Marketing Research: How to Evaluate and When to Trust](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13995)
*Oded Netzer,Rajan Sambandam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文讨论合成数据在营销研究中的适用时机，提出三种合成数据类型与四类准确性度量分类，并引入"遗忘问题"场景与无需真值的可答性诊断方法（随机森林R²），在108个态度问题上验证其筛选效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于合成数据的争论两极分化：一方认为LLM使人类受访者过时，另一方主张完全避免使用。作者认为双方都忽视了更关键的问题——不是合成受访者是否有效，而是在何种条件下有效。

Method: 基于Brand, Israeli和Ngwe (2026)，区分三类合成数据（无根据的LLM回答、群体层面persona、个体层面digital twin）并匹配其可支持的决策；构建四类准确性度量分类法；提出"遗忘问题"（fielded研究中遗漏某问题）作为twin增强现有数据的场景，并设计事前可答性诊断——用随机森林从构造twin的数据预测twin输出的R²，无需ground truth。

Result: 在108个态度问题、N=3,063的全国代表性调查中，以R²>0.7筛选使twin-人类个体层面平均相关性提升15%，表现差的问题占比从25.9%降至4.3%。嵌入相似度与资深研究者判断提供相关但较弱的筛选效果。

Conclusion: twin准确性的巨大差异主要反映"测什么"而非方法质量；聚合指标常在信息很少时也表现良好，会掩盖个体层面区分能力的完全缺失。可答性诊断能有效事前筛选适用问题。

Abstract: Debate over synthetic data in marketing research has polarized between claims that large language models (LLMs) make human respondents obsolete and calls to avoid them entirely. We argue that both positions obscure the more useful question: not whether synthetic respondents work, but when. Building on Brand, Israeli, and Ngwe (2026), we make three contributions. First, we distinguish three types of synthetic data (ungrounded LLM responses, segment-level personas, and individual-level digital twins) and map each to the decisions it can support. Second, we develop a taxonomy of four families of accuracy measures and suggest that the wide range of reported twin accuracy, from near-perfect to near-chance, largely reflects differences in what is being measured rather than in method quality. Aggregate measures often perform well even when little information is supplied to the LLM, and can mask a complete absence of respondent-level differentiation. Third, we introduce the forgotten question problem, in which a question is omitted from a fielded study, as a setting for twin-based augmentation of existing data. We propose an ex-ante answerability diagnostic that requires no ground truth: the R^2 of a random forest predicting twin outputs from the data used to construct the twins. Across 108 attitude questions from a nationally representative survey (N = 3,063), screening at R^2 above 0.7 raises the mean twin-human individual-level correlation by 15% and reduces the share of poorly answered questions from 25.9% to 4.3%. Embedding similarity and experienced-researcher judgment provide correlated but weaker screens.

</details>


### [390] [Convergent Emergence of In-Context Learning Across Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14011)
*Nathan Breslow,Seungwook Han,Daniel Hyunsoo Lee,Aayush Mishra,Anqi Liu,Daniel Khashabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"趋同涌现假说"（Convergent Emergence Hypothesis），即few-shot ICL在不同模态中若涌现，应共享相似的跨模态任务难度分布。作者构建跨模态受控框架，在六种模态上实例化相同任务套件，发现配对映射ICL在六种模态中均涌现并超越基线，且在五种模态中呈现任务级相关效应，部分支持该假说。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: few-shot ICL已在人类文本训练的LLM中广泛研究，近期在自回归基因组模型中也出现。这引发疑问：ICL是否跨领域普遍涌现？若如此，是否存在共同结构？

Method: 构建受控跨模态框架，在语言、基因组、整数序列、时间序列、图像和蛋白质六种模态上实例化同一任务套件，用以检验"趋同涌现假说"。

Result: 配对映射ICL在六种模态中均涌现，超越受控基线；在六种模态中的五种上呈现任务级相关效应。

Conclusion: 结果部分支持趋同涌现假说，但并非所有模态都符合。

Abstract: Few-shot in-context learning (ICL), the capacity of a model to infer abstract patterns from input-output examples provided in its prompt and apply them to new inputs, has been extensively studied in large language models trained for next-token prediction on human text. Recently, few-shot ICL has been demonstrated in autoregressive genomic models as well. This raises a question: does ICL emerge broadly across domains, and if so, what common structure is shared?
  To address both, we develop a controlled cross-modality framework that instantiates the same task suite in a variety of modalities to test what we call the Convergent Emergence Hypothesis: the idea that few-shot ICL, when it emerges, shares a common cross-modality difficulty profile - i.e., tasks that benefit from ICL in one modality tend to benefit in others. We show that paired-mapping ICL emerges across six modalities (language, genome, integer sequences, time series, images, and proteins), surpasses controlled baselines, and has correlated per-task effects across five of them. Together, these results provide support for the Convergent Emergence Hypothesis in some modalities, but not all.

</details>


### [391] [Schizophrenia Detection from EEG Signals: A Transformer Framework with Spectrogram Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14015)
*Abtin Shafiei,Mohsen Hooshmand,Majid Ramezani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于EEG时频图的精神分裂症分类框架，采用受试者级划分避免数据泄漏，CNN-Transformer混合模型在独立测试集上达到92.88% AUC-ROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精神分裂症诊断主要依赖临床评估，EEG具自动化检测潜力，但现有研究存在数据集小、预处理不一致、评估未防止受试者相关数据泄漏等问题。

Method: 将预处理EEG经短时傅里叶变换转为时频（频谱图）表示，使用传统机器学习（SVM、随机森林、XGBoost）及深度学习（卷积架构、CNN-Transformer混合）进行分类，所有数据划分在受试者级别进行。

Result: 在独立测试集上取得具竞争力的性能，CNN-Transformer（CT-SZ）AUC-ROC为88.41%，CNN+SE+Transformer（CST-SZ）AUC-ROC为92.88%。

Conclusion: 基于EEG时频图并结合严格受试者级评估的框架可有效支持精神分裂症自动检测，CNN-Transformer混合模型表现最佳。

Abstract: Schizophrenia is a serious psychiatric disorder that affects millions of people worldwide, and its diagnosis remains primarily dependent on clinical assessment. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive approach to investigate brain activity and has shown potential to support automated Schizophrenia detection. However, existing EEG-based classification studies often suffer from limitations including small datasets, inconsistent preprocessing strategies, and evaluation protocols that may not adequately prevent subject-related data leakage. In this study, we propose an EEG-based Schizophrenia classification framework that transforms preprocessed EEG recordings into time-frequency representations using the Short-Time Fourier Transform. The generated spectrogram images are classified using both conventional Machine Learning algorithms, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and XGBoost, and Deep Learning models, including convolutional architectures and CNN-Transformer hybrids. To ensure reliable evaluation, all data partitions are performed at the subject level. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive classification performance, with the CNN-Transformer (CT-SZ) model achieving an AUC-ROC of 88.41% and the CNN + Squeeze and Excitation + Transformer (CST-SZ) achieving an AUC-ROC of 92.88% on the independent test set.

</details>


### [392] [VeriDx: Earning the Right to Diagnose with Disease-Centric Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14018)
*Zhong Cao,Shuying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VeriDx框架，从"疾病假设引发的临床义务"角度验证医学LLM的诊断推理，揭示诊断错误往往是推理早期未履行的义务所致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学LLM评估只关注最终答案、局部步骤或孤立事实，忽略了疾病假设所引发的临床义务（如检查关键证据、排除替代诊断、解决矛盾、合理收尾），从而无法发现"答案正确但推理错误"的失败。

Method: VeriDx是一个以疾病为中心的验证框架，将自由形式的诊断推理与结构化疾病档案相链接，追踪每个假设是满足、未解决还是违反了其临床义务，从而暴露缺失关键检查、未解决鉴别诊断、忽视矛盾、无支撑主张和过早收尾等失败。框架在复杂呼吸系统诊断上实例化，使用指南衍生的疾病档案与专家标注的纵向病例。

Result: 结果表明，许多诊断错误并非孤立失误，而是推理过程中早期未履行的义务所导致的连锁后果。

Conclusion: 对医学LLM的评估应从答案正确性转向疾病假设义务的履行情况，VeriDx提供了这种疾病中心式的验证路径，有助于更深入地理解诊断失败的根本原因。

Abstract: A correct diagnosis can still be reached for the wrong reasons. In clinical reasoning, every disease hypothesis creates obligations: key evidence must be checked, alternatives must be ruled out, contradictions must be resolved, useful tests must be considered, and closure must be justified. Current evaluations of medical LLMs mostly focus on final answers, local steps, or isolated facts, and therefore miss these hypothesis-induced commitments. We introduce \textbf{VeriDx}, a disease-centric verification framework that links free-form diagnostic reasoning to structured disease profiles. VeriDx tracks whether each hypothesis is satisfied, unresolved, or violated its clinical obligations, exposing failures such as missing critical tests, unresolved differentials, ignored contradictions, unsupported claims, and premature closure. We instantiate VeriDx for complex respiratory diagnosis using guideline-derived disease profiles and expert-annotated longitudinal cases. Our results show that many diagnostic errors are not isolated mistakes, but broken commitments made earlier in the reasoning process.

</details>


### [393] [Semantic Knowledge Technologies: what the Semantic Web lost sight of, and what it never had](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14121)
*Achille Zappa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文主张语义网原始目标正确但技术方案不完整，提出"语义知识技术"扩展纲领：通过补齐条件、操作与覆盖三个缺失维度，将知识标准从网页发布扩展至任意知识载体，并定义五项理解测试与七层架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义网本应赋予信息机器可解释、可推理的形式，其标准已成为科学知识基础设施，但承诺的机器能力并未实现。当前回答科学知识问题的系统是语言模型，它们对所掌握的知识没有可审查的说明。作者认为原目标正确，问题在于技术方案不完整，需要指出缺失之处并命名扩展纲领。

Method: 诊断现有标准的形式化缺陷：标准形式化了"真"，却遗漏三点——主张成立的条件、术语允许的操作、知识库覆盖范围的说明。基于此将"理解"固定为五项可测测试（检查、连接、推导、行动、界定边界），并提出七层架构，前三层为使能层，其余为由此可能的认知能力。

Result: 论文定义三个纲领性术语：大知识模型（输出单元是可寻址主张的引用而非词元）、SLKM（智能体从声明来源自建的知识库）、语义通用人工智能（关于必要条件的可证伪立场而非系统）；并以分级阶梯替代不可测的"通用"一词。

Conclusion: 本文作为研究议程提出，明确列出其最薄弱环节与证伪条件，呼吁将语义知识技术作为扩展纲领推进。

Abstract: The Semantic Web set out to give information a machine-interpretable form so that software could integrate and reason over it. Its standards became scientific knowledge infrastructure, but the machine competence it promised did not follow, and the systems now answering questions over scientific knowledge are language models holding no inspectable account of what they know. This paper argues the original goal was right and the technical programme incomplete, states what is missing, and names the extended programme Semantic Knowledge Technologies: the same technical core carried out of its web-publishing origin and applied to knowledge wherever held. The diagnosis is that the standards formalised truth while omitting three things: the conditions under which a claim holds, the operations its terms permit, and any account of what a base covers. Without conditions, contradiction and applicability cannot be judged; without operational grounding, holding a statement confers no ability; without declared coverage, a system cannot recognise the boundary of its own content, which under the open-world assumption cannot be inferred. The paper fixes the word understanding to five measurable tests (check, connect, derive, act, delimit) and sets out a seven-layer architecture in which the first three layers are enabling and the rest the cognitive capabilities they make possible. It then defines three terms the programme implies: Large Knowledge Model, a model whose unit of output is a reference to an addressable claim, not a token; SLKM, the knowledge base an agent builds for itself from declared sources; and Semantic Artificial General Intelligence, stated as a falsifiable position about necessary conditions, not a system. A graded ladder replaces the untestable word general. It is offered as a research agenda, with its weakest points and refutation condition named.

</details>


### [394] [MOSCOPT: Mixture-of-Skills Collective Optimization for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14399)
*Zhenyu Zhang1,Jiudong Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MOSCOPT是一种文本原生、无需参数的算法，通过联合优化技能池和门控技能，实现LLM智能体的提示与技能协同优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示与技能优化方法仅优化单一文本模板，忽略了多种互补策略间的协同效应。

Method: 提出MOSCOPT，联合优化N个技能池和一个门控技能G（每步动态选择K个技能）；构建带内部双状态的EditAdam，通过三阶段交错更新实现无梯度的单调改进。

Result: 在5个基准和3个目标LLM上，MOSCOPT一致优于所有基线；消融实验证实混合技能架构与选择性激活、三阶段交错协同演化是关键。

Conclusion: MOSCOPT通过技能混合与协同演化显著提升LLM智能体性能，代码已开源。

Abstract: Natural language prompts and skills serve as the strategic backbone of LLM-based agents. Recent advances in prompt and skill optimization have achieved notable gains, yet all existing methods optimize a \emph{single} text template---missing the synergy among multiple complementary strategies. We propose MOSCOPT, a text-native, parameter-free algorithm that jointly optimizes a pool of $N$ skills and a gating skill $G$ that dynamically selects $K$ skills per step. To effectively optimize the skills, we build the EditAdam with internally maintained dual states. Through the three-phase interleaved updates with EditAdam, the system monotonically improves without gradient or parameter tuning. Extensive experiments and detailed ablations across 5 benchmarks and 3 target LLMs demonstrate that MOSCOPT consistently outperforms all baselines, and confirm that both the mixture-of-skills architecture with selective activation and the collective evolution with three-phase interleaving are essential to its superior performance. Code is released https://github.com/zhangzhenyu13/SummerClaw/tree/master/summerclaw/agent_trainer/algorithms/moscopt.

</details>


### [395] [Dynamic Learning Solutions: A System for Personalized Educational Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14408)
*Siddhanth Sridhar,Shreya Chaurasia,Baddela Sai Yaswantha Reddy,Deepak Parmar,Shylaja S S*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化流水线，将NCERT教材PDF转换为可交互的视频讲解，整合RAG检索、Stable Diffusion图像生成、DynamiCrafter动画与TTS语音合成，实现多模态教育内容生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将静态教材转化为可交互、个性化的数字教育内容，响应用户查询并提升学习参与度，同时解决文本与视觉多模态内容的理解与生成问题。

Method: 用户上传PDF并提问；RAG模型针对NCERT教材结构优化，检索相关内容并生成多场景脚本（叙述+结构化视觉提示）；Stable Diffusion逐层生成图像；DynamiCrafter将图像转为动画；Google TTS生成同步旁白，通过时间控制对齐语音与画面。

Result: 系统能输出整合动画、旁白与教材对齐视觉内容的连贯视频讲解，RAG阶段在NCERT教材内容上表现最佳。

Conclusion: 通过结合多模态文档检索、生成式视觉模型、动画框架与语音合成，该流水线展示了可扩展的交互式个性化数字教育内容生成方案。

Abstract: We present an automated pipeline that converts NCERT textbooks into interactive video explanations that respond directly to user queries. A user uploads a PDF and asks a question; the system then generates a video-based explanation as output, handling both text and visual elements from the PDF for multi-modal retrieval and response generation. The pipeline combines a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) model with generative multimedia components. The RAG stage is optimized for the structure of NCERT textbooks and performs best on content from those books. Given a user query, the RAG model retrieves relevant content from the PDF and generates a multi-scene script containing narrative explanations and structured visual prompts aligned with the textbook's explanatory style. These prompts are passed to a Stable Diffusion module, implemented layer by layer for interpretability and control, which generates contextually relevant images. The images are then processed by DynamiCrafter to produce animated sequences. Finally, a Google Text-to-Speech module generates synchronized narration, aligning speech with the visual scenes through time-based control. The result is a coherent video explanation integrating animation, narration, and textbook-aligned visuals, transforming static educational material into an engaging learning experience. By combining multi-modal document retrieval, generative visual models, animation frameworks, and speech synthesis, this pipeline demonstrates a scalable approach to delivering interactive, personalized digital education content.

</details>


### [396] [Question's Gambit: The First Move Matters in Agentic Deep Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14412)
*Radin Hamidi Rad,Amin Bigdeli,Negar Arabzadeh,Sajad Ebrahimi,Charles L. A. Clarke,Benjamin C. M. Fung,Ebrahim Bagheri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个检索动作模块Question's Gambit，通过问题分解、互补检索、合并与重排，优化深度研究智能体的开局上下文，显著提升检索召回与答案准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度研究智能体虽迭代搜索推理，且配置良好的词汇检索能提供高质量证据，但智能体仍可能无法把含证据的文档与金标准文档关联。作者认为首个检索动作是关键设计决策。

Method: Question's Gambit：将问题分解为线索集合，改写为互补查询，检索结果合并并重排候选池，在智能体开始迭代搜索推理前构建一个支持线索聚合与最终答案验证的开局上下文。并在MultiHop-RAG上验证迁移性。

Result: 在BrowseComp-Plus上，相比最强基线Pi-Serini，使用gpt-5.5时答案准确率从83.1%提升至90.5%，检索召回与下游准确率均提升。

Conclusion: 有效的智能体深度研究不仅依赖循环内可用工具，也取决于首个检索动作的质量。

Abstract: Deep research agents answer complex questions through iterative loops of searching, reading, and reasoning. Recent work on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as BrowseComp-Plus shows that well-configured lexical retrieval can surface high-quality evidence, yet agents may still fail to connect documents carrying evidence to the gold documents. We identify a deep research agent's first retrieval move as an important design decision for this setting. We introduce Question's Gambit, a first-move retrieval module that decomposes the question into a set of clues, reformulates them into complementary searches, consolidates the retrieved results, and reranks the candidate pool before the agent begins its iterative search-and-reasoning process. This produces an opening context designed to support both clue aggregation and final-answer verification. We further evaluate on MultiHop-RAG to test whether these benefits transfer beyond BrowseComp-Plus to a more conventional multi-hop question structure. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus show that Question's Gambit improves retrieval recall and downstream agent accuracy over strong baselines, improving answer accuracy from 83.1% to 90.5% with gpt-5.5 over Pi-Serini, the strongest reported agentic baseline. Our results confirm that effective agentic deep research depends not only on the tools available inside the loop, but also on the quality of the first move. We published our implementation publicly at https://github.com/radinhamidi/Question-s-Gambit.

</details>


### [397] [Safety Signals to Verify NetOps Agents with Action-Level Granularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14422)
*Tobias Labarta,Frederik Pahde,Novak Boskov,Maximilian Dreyer,David Birkenberger,Manzoor Ahmed Khan,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文为NetOps代理的网络修复任务构建了动作级ground truth，并揭示代理内部信号比可观测信号更能可靠预测动作的危害与进展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic NetOps有望实现自主网络，但其作为控制回路引擎的可靠性依赖长视界可靠性，尤其需在高风险动作前进行"弃权"。弃权需预知动作影响，而现有NetOps代理基准缺乏逐动作ground truth。

Method: 针对NetArena的网络修复任务，对仿真网络进行符号化重放，并在每步与环境验证，从而得到每个动作的精确价值；由此导出两个执行前目标：动作是否减少修复距离（progress）及是否增加修复距离（harm）。

Result: 在10个代理模型上测试，利用内部信号的代理验证器比仅用可观测信号的基线更可靠地预测危害与进展。

Conclusion: 这些信号有望作为安全反馈接入代理框架，使其规避高风险动作并保护目标系统。

Abstract: Agentic Network Operations (NetOps) are an emerging paradigm promising to enable workload-aware, self-adjustable, and reliable autonomous networks. While agents have proven their value in incident summarization and telemetry signal extraction, their effectiveness as autonomous control-loop engines heavily relies on their long-horizon reliability. One such setting is the datacenter fabric, where an agent must respond to alarms and operator intents while abstaining from high-risk actions that may cause or extend downtime. Abstention, however, presupposes that an action's impact is known pre-execution, which necessitates a per-action ground truth that NetOps agent benchmarks do not provide. We construct such a ground truth for the network repair task of NetArena. A symbolic replay of the emulated network, validated against the environment at every turn, yields the exact value of every action. From the action-level value, we derive two pre-execution targets, namely whether an action reduces the repair distance (progress) and whether it increases it (harm). We show across 10 agent models, that agent verifiers leveraging internal signals predict both harm and progress more reliably than a baseline using observable signals only. Perspectively, we aim to use these signals as safety feedback to an agent harness to abstain from risky actions and protect the target system.

</details>


### [398] [When does a scaling result justify a different allocation? A critical review of resource-allocation evidence for AI systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14500)
*Seyed Morteza Emadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇批判性整合综述，探讨AI扩展性研究中的评估结果何时能真正支持资源分配决策。作者提出"能力面"和"资源包"两个框架，以区分被测流程的性能与资源约束下的最优性能，并识别出三类反复出现的评估错配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统评估越来越多涉及预训练模型与检索、搜索、验证、工具和交互的组合。然而，在更大预算下获得更高分数，本身并不能说明资源应投向何处。现有的扩展性研究缺少对"报告结果是否支持资源分配决策"的判断标准，导致性能比较与部署决策之间存在脱节。

Method: 采用批判性整合综述方法，横向比较预训练、测试时计算、检索和智能体评估四个方面的证据。通过区分"被测程序性能"与"资源约束下可达到的最优性能"，识别三类错配（答案选定前即计成功、使用部署系统不会拥有的信息、比较中遗漏成本）。提出"能力面"（将性能表达为预算、机制和可用信息的函数）和"资源包"（记录任务、开发与运行时资源、信息访问和流程的结构化记录）两个框架。

Result: 综述发现三类错配在各类证据中反复出现。通过分析性示例，展示了评估指标、部署量、选择规则和停止策略如何改变资源分配结论。将资源包应用于一项已发表的比较研究，说明了哪些结论有证据支持、哪些部署问题仍无定论。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架明确了在可行的系统之间进行选择所需的比较方法，并推动关于资源分配规则跨任务和运行条件迁移的实验研究。该框架不主张普遍适用的扩展定律，也不从基准提升推断通用智能。

Abstract: AI scaling studies increasingly evaluate systems that combine a pretrained model with retrieval, search, verification, tools, and interaction. Yet a higher score under a larger budget does not by itself show where additional resources are best spent. This critical integrative review asks when a reported scaling result supports a resource-allocation decision. It compares evidence across pretraining, test-time computation, retrieval, and agent evaluation, distinguishing the performance of a tested procedure from the best performance achievable under a resource limit. The synthesis shows that three mismatches recur across this evidence: success counted before an answer is chosen, information a deployed system will not have, and costs left out of the comparison. A capability surface expresses performance as a function of budgets, mechanisms, and available information. Worked analytical examples show how the evaluation metric, deployment volume, selection rule, and stopping policy can alter an allocation conclusion. A resource envelope provides a structured record of the task, development and run-time resources, information access, and procedure behind a reported score. Its application to a published comparison illustrates which conclusions the evidence supports and which deployment questions remain unresolved. The resulting framework specifies the comparisons needed to choose among feasible systems and motivates experiments on the transfer of allocation rules across tasks and operating conditions. It does not propose a universal scaling law or infer general intelligence from benchmark gains.

</details>


### [399] [Beyond Scene Description: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Non-visual Access to Virtual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14512)
*Toqeer Ali Syed,Ali Akarma,Adeel Ahmad,Danial Hameed*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MetaBlind提出一种多智能体非视觉访问架构，用八个专用智能体加上一个无障碍编排器，在共享上下文中筛选信息，避免听觉过载，论文处于设计阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚拟世界已成为课堂、会议、商店和社交场所，但其交互默认假设用户能扫描三维场景、跟随化身、阅读浮动面板。视障（BVI）用户现有辅助工具各自只解决单一任务（命名物体、读文本、描述场景、规划路线）。而实时虚拟房间中障碍、发言人、手势、聊天、幻灯片和通知同时出现，单一工具若全部播报，只是把视觉障碍换成听觉障碍。

Method: 提出MetaBlind架构，将非视觉访问分散到八个专用智能体（感知、导航、社交与物体交互、交流、安全与信任、记忆、个性化等），并在这些智能体与用户之间放置一个无障碍编排器。智能体不直接对用户说话，而是把候选信息发布到共享无障碍上下文；编排器按安全相关性、目标相关性、紧迫性、置信度、用户相关性和预计听觉负担对候选打分，仅释放当下相关的信息，通过语音、结构化音频或触觉输出。论文给出选择步骤的形式化表述、编排周期的算法规范，并定义了对照单智能体助手的评估协议。

Result: MetaBlind目前为设计阶段成果，没有原型测量或用户研究。评估协议说明了哪些结果会支持该设计、哪些会反驳它。

Conclusion: 该工作提出以编排器协调多智能体的非视觉信息访问框架，用于应对虚拟世界中的信息并发与听觉过载问题，后续需通过既定评估协议进行实证验证。

Abstract: Virtual worlds now host classrooms, meetings, conferences, shops, and social venues, and nearly every interaction they expose assumes a user who can scan a three-dimensional scene, follow avatars, and read floating panels. Blind and visually impaired (BVI) users are left with assistive tools that each solve one task in isolation: naming an object, reading text, describing a scene, or planning a route. A live virtual room defeats that model: obstacles, speakers, gestures, chat, slides, and notifications arrive together, and a tool that narrates all of them trades a visual barrier for an auditory one. This paper presents MetaBlind, an architecture that distributes nonvisual access across eight specialized agents, spanning perception, navigation, social and object interaction, communication, safety and trust, memory, and personalization, and that places an Accessibility Orchestrator between those agents and the user. Agents publish candidate information into a shared accessibility context instead of speaking to the user directly. The orchestrator scores each candidate on safety relevance, goal relevance, urgency, confidence, user relevance, and estimated listening load, then releases only the items it judges relevant at that moment through speech, structured audio, or haptic output. We give the selection step a formal statement, specify the orchestration cycle as an algorithm, and define an evaluation protocol against a single-agent assistant. MetaBlind is reported at the design stage, with no prototype measurement or user study, and the protocol states which outcomes would support the design and which would refute it.

</details>


### [400] [OptoAgent: A Trustworthy Multi-Agent Framework for Opportunistic Vision Micro-Screening in Classroom Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14514)
*Toqeer Ali Syed,Ali Akarma,Adeel Ahmad,Hammad Muneer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SightSentinel架构：将儿童日常观看的墙面显示内容嵌入校准视标探针，配合八个智能体从多次低质观测中提取视觉线索，经质量门控与纵向基线累积生成"视力关注评分"以触发转诊，并给出四阶段临床验证方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童远视力下降往往不自知，会自我适应、靠近观看且极少主动报告，问题可能潜伏多年才被成人发现。学校筛查受排期与人员限制、脱离课堂真实场景；手机与网页视力测试虽扩大可及性，但仍需有人主动发起测试。因此需要一个无需人工启动、嵌入日常场景的持续筛查方案。

Method: 将短小校准视标探针嵌入教育内容，投射于儿童日常所看的墙面显示器。由八个专用智能体分工：感知智能体从每次接触中提取观看距离、识别准确度、靠近行为、注视稳定性、反应时延与双眼差异；质量智能体剔除几何条件差、光照不佳或注意力涣散时的观测；纵向智能体仅将合格证据与儿童自身基线累积比较；编排智能体输出视力关注评分，并经安全门控限制输出范围（排除诊断、验光、处方与安抚性结论）。同时给出形式化表述与四阶段临床参考标准验证协议。

Result: 论文为架构与方案性工作：提出形式化表述、架构设计及四阶段验证协议，并明确该方法应被否决的条件；未报告实证性能数据。

Conclusion: 核心设计问题在于：大量廉价、含噪但经良好门控的观测，能否达成一次计划性测试往往过晚或遗漏的转诊决策。作者主张以安全门控避免越界诊断，并预设可证伪的否决条件以指导后续验证。

Abstract: A child with reduced distance vision often does not know that anything is wrong. Children adapt, move closer, and rarely report the difficulty, so the problem can survive years of schooling before an adult notices. School screening addresses part of this, but it runs on a schedule, depends on staffing, and is separated from the classroom moments where the difficulty appears. Smartphone and web-based acuity tests have widened access, yet every one of them still needs somebody to start a test. We present SightSentinel, an architecture that turns a wall display a child already reads from into a recurring screening site. Ordinary educational content carries short calibrated optotype probes, and eight specialized agents divide the work. Perception agents recover viewing distance, recognition accuracy, approach behavior, gaze stability, response latency, and interocular difference from each encounter. A quality agent discards observations taken under bad geometry, poor lighting, or inattention. A longitudinal agent accumulates only the surviving evidence against the child's own baseline, and an orchestrator reports a Vision Concern Score routed through a safety gate whose output range excludes diagnosis, refraction, prescription, and reassurance. The design question is whether many cheap, noisy, well-gated encounters can reach a referral decision that one scheduled test reaches late or misses. We state the formulation, the architecture, a four-stage validation protocol against clinical reference standards, and the conditions under which the approach should be rejected.

</details>


### [401] [AI Deployment Accountability Engineering: A Vision for Accountable AI in Safety-Critical Socio-Technical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14592)
*Murat Kantarcioglu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"AI部署问责工程"（ADAE）这一新子学科，主张问责应作为部署层属性，并围绕四大支柱构建研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI评估以模型为中心，关注准确率、鲁棒性、公平性等属性，但当AI系统运行于动态社会技术环境（分布漂移、制度约束、人类反馈、隐私、多智能体交互）时，这些属性虽有必但不足。

Method: 作为愿景论文，提出ADAE概念框架：将问责视为部署层属性，确定系统是否在可接受风险范围内运行、识别失效上下文、跨技术与人因组件归因、将技术失效转化为下游后果并支持及时干预。

Result: 围绕四大互联支柱构建研究议程：情境依赖失效模式的结构化发现、隐私保护的问责度量、面向智能体AI的系统级风险分析、技术失效向运营与制度风险的转化。

Conclusion: 目标是为安全关键领域的可问责AI部署建立基础原则、数学工具与系统架构。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems are rapidly becoming critical components in healthcare, finance, public services, and other safety-critical domains. Yet the engineering practices used to evaluate these systems remain predominantly model-centric, emphasizing properties such as accuracy, robustness, fairness, and interpretability before deployment. These properties are necessary but insufficient once an AI system operates within an ever changing socio-technical environment characterized by distribution shifts, institutional constraints, human feedback loops, privacy requirements, and interactions among multiple AI agents.
  This vision paper introduces AI Deployment Accountability Engineering (ADAE), a proposed AI engineering subdiscipline concerned with establishing measurable, continuous, and actionable accountability for deployed AI systems. ADAE treats accountability as a deployment-layer property rather than solely as a property of an individual model. It seeks to determine whether an AI-enabled system continues to operate within acceptable risk limits, identify the contexts in which failures emerge, attribute failures across interacting technical and human components, translate technical failures into downstream consequences, and support timely intervention.
  We articulate a research agenda built around four interconnected pillars: structured discovery of context-dependent failure modes, privacy-preserving accountability measurement, system-level risk analysis for agentic AI, and translation of technical failures into operational, and institutional risks. The broader goal is to establish foundational principles, mathematical tools, and system architectures for accountable AI deployment across safety-critical applications.

</details>


### [402] [A note on goal-based hierarchical RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14605)
*Kevin Murphy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将 ACGVF 与基于内部信念状态 z_t 的通用智能体设计，通过层级隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM）统一并扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ACGVF 框架让智能体可自主选择目标及终止时机，但假设环境完全可观测；而 murphy2025rl 引入了内部信念状态，却假设目标由外部提供。本文旨在统一两者的优势，弥补各自局限。

Method: 采用层级隐马尔可夫模型（HHMM）形式化，将 ACGVF 的智能体中心目标选择与 murphy2025rl 的内部信念状态智能体设计相结合，实现目标自主生成与部分可观测环境下的统一建模。

Result: 提出了一个统一并扩展上述两种方法的框架，能够在部分可观测条件下支持智能体内部信念与内部目标的联合决策。

Conclusion: HHMM 可有效整合 ACGVF 与内部信念智能体设计，为不完全可观测环境下的通用智能体建模提供统一形式化基础。

Abstract: The agent-centric general value function (ACGVF) construction of
  \citet{tasse2026goal} lets the agent make two decisions that are
  normally imposed by the environment or agent designer: which goal to
  pursue and when to declare a goal as finished (in addition to
  choosing the action). This is a very general framework that
  subsumes almost all prior work on reinforcement learning, control
  and planning, as well as more general formalisms proposed in the
  cognitive sciences. However, it assumes the environment is fully
  observed, i.e., that the observation is a sufficient statistic. In
  \citet{murphy2025rl}, a general agent design was proposed where the
  policy is based on an internal belief state $z_t$ and an internal
  goal; however, the goals were assumed to be externally provided. In
  this note, we unify and extend these two approaches using the
  formalism of hierarchical hidden Markov models (HHMM) \citep{murphy2001hhmm}.

</details>


### [403] [DynSTEER: Dynamic Stage-wise Trajectory Evaluation and Execution-time Review for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14637)
*Zhichao Shi,Wenjie Zhang,Xuhui Jiang,Xiaojun Wu,Cehao Yang,Chengjin Xu,Jian Guo,Yuanzhuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DynSTEER，一种面向LLM智能体的动态分阶段轨迹评估框架，解决仅看终态、单一参考匹配和高成本事后评判的三大评估局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体长时程任务评估存在三大问题：仅评估最终结果，忽略中间过程且难以高效准确定位错误；单一参考答案匹配会惩罚合法的替代解法；事后轨迹评判成本高且无法提前中止失败运行。

Method: DynSTEER将执行轨迹按关键已完成动作切分为多个阶段，聚焦必要里程碑并提供充分上下文；从公开任务视图编译出路径容忍的里程碑图，在不泄露ground truth的前提下容纳多种合法策略；并将评估查询自适应路由至多层级评判器，在线中止不可恢复的执行以节省资源。

Result: 相比原生评估，DynSTEER对LLM智能体的评估区分度提升85.2%，能以统计显著性区分所有模型对，并在失败轨迹上节省34.51%的执行步骤。

Conclusion: DynSTEER通过分阶段、路径容忍和自适应评判，实现了更高效、更准确且成本更低的智能体轨迹评估。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for long-horizon task execution. However, current evaluation paradigms face three major limitations: terminal-only assessment ignores intermediate processes and struggles to localize errors efficiently and accurately, single-reference matching penalizes valid alternative solution paths, and post-hoc trajectory judging incurs high costs without the ability to halt failed runs early. To address these issues, we propose DynSTEER, a dynamic stage-wise trajectory evaluation framework for agents. DynSTEER segments rollouts into stages anchored by key completed actions, focusing evaluation on essential milestones with adequate context while enabling targeted strategy adjustments. It compiles a path-tolerant milestone graph from public task views to respect diverse legitimate strategies without leaking ground truth. Furthermore, it adaptively routes evaluation queries across multi-tier judges and halts unrecoverable executions online to curb resource waste. Experiments demonstrate that DynSTEER improves evaluation discriminability across LLM agents by 85.2\% over native evaluation, separates all model pairs with statistical significance, and saves 34.51\% of execution steps on failed rollouts.

</details>


### [404] [Diffusion-Based Generation of Gait Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14642)
*Damian Benasco,Juan Carballeira-Lopez,Jaime Ramos-Rojas,Julio S. Lora-Millan,Antonio J. Del-Ama,David Rodriguez-Cianca,Pablo Lanillos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探索用条件扩散模型生成基于步长等参数的个性化下肢关节角步态轨迹，并对比基线Transformer扩散模型与可控扩散Transformer变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴机器人和康复辅助系统（如下肢外骨骼）需要能适应个体形态和治疗目标的参考轨迹并保持生物力学真实性，但传统手工步态模板或优化方法难以跨受试者和行走条件扩展。

Method: 采用条件扩散模型生成以步长等步态参数为条件的下肢关节角轨迹，对比基线Transformer扩散模型与引入自适应归一化和无分类器引导的可控扩散Transformer变体，在4590个步态周期数据集上实验。

Result: 扩散模型能生成逼真的周期性步态轨迹，并在步态特征上实现一定的可控性变化。

Conclusion: 条件扩散模型在辅助机器人个性化步态合成方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Generation of musculoskeletal gait trajectories conditioned on patient-specific parameters remains a key challenge for wearable robotics and rehabilitation. Assistive systems such as lower-limb exoskeletons require reference trajectories that adapt to individual morphology and therapeutic goals while preserving biomechanical realism. Traditional approaches rely on hand-crafted gait templates or optimization procedures that scale poorly across subjects and walking conditions. In this work, we explore conditional diffusion models for generating lower-limb joint-angle trajectories conditioned on gait parameters such as step length. We compare a baseline transformer diffusion model with a controllable diffusion transformer variant incorporating adaptive normalization and classifier-free guidance. Experiments on a dataset of 4,590 gait cycles show that diffusion models can generate realistic periodic gait trajectories while enabling some controllability variation in gait characteristics, highlighting their potential for personalized gait synthesis in assistive robotics.

</details>


### [405] [Lightning Weave: Improving the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier of Reasoning Models through Capability Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14708)
*Yecheng Wu,Song Han,Han Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Lightning Weave是一个后训练框架，通过on-policy蒸馏将独立训练的准确率专家和效率专家能力组合到单一学生模型中，实现更优的准确率-效率前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效推理的核心目标是提升准确率-效率前沿，但联合提升推理准确率与推理效率具有挑战性，因为二者可能偏好不同的推理行为。而已有独立后训练模型分别具备准确率和效率方面的优势，因此需要一种方法来组合这些独立学到的能力。

Method: Lightning Weave通过on-policy蒸馏，将每个已获得能力表示后训练前后模型的策略偏移（policy shift）。它在学生共享token状态上组合对齐的log-ratio偏移，并使用Tilted-Target DOPD将缓存信号转化为稳定的学习目标。每个anchor对只需对缓存轨迹评分一次，从而后续学生训练无需同时服务多个实时anchor模型。

Result: 在多种学生模型及数学、代码基准上，Lightning Weave显著优于基础学生模型并达到最先进的准确率-效率前沿。在Qwen3.5-4B上，HMMT 2025准确率从59.2%提升至64.0%，响应token减少10.7%；LiveCodeBench v5准确率从41.7%提升至54.2%，响应token减少9.6%。调整anchor信号相对强度可得到较强的准确率-效率Pareto前沿。

Conclusion: 结果确立了Lightning Weave作为一种通过能力组合实现高效推理的新实用路径，代码即将发布。

Abstract: A core goal of efficient reasoning is to improve the accuracy-efficiency frontier. However, jointly improving reasoning accuracy and inference efficiency can be challenging, as the two objectives can favor different reasoning behaviors. Independently post-trained models already offer distinct strengths in accuracy and efficiency. We introduce Lightning Weave, a post-training framework that extracts and composes these independently learned capabilities in a single student through on-policy distillation. Each acquired capability is represented by the policy shift from the model before post-training to the resulting specialist. Lightning Weave combines aligned log-ratio shifts at shared student token states and uses Tilted-Target DOPD to convert the cached signals into a stable learning target. Each anchor pair scores the cached trajectories once, enabling subsequent student training without serving multiple live anchor models concurrently. Across diverse student models and benchmarks in mathematics and code, Lightning Weave substantially improves upon the base students and achieves a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency frontier. On Qwen3.5-4B, it raises HMMT 2025 accuracy from 59.2% to 64.0% with 10.7% fewer response tokens, and LiveCodeBench v5 accuracy from 41.7% to 54.2% with 9.6% fewer response tokens. Adjusting the relative strengths of the anchor signals yields a strong empirical accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier. These results establish Lightning Weave as a new practical route to efficient reasoning through capability composition. Code will be released soon.

</details>


### [406] [Depth and Scale in the Sub-150M Regime: JugnuLM-53M vs JugnuLM-110M](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14715)
*Dushyant Rajput,Nirdesh Chauhan,Siddharth Kosaraju*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将150M以下的预训练配方从53.5M扩展到109.7M参数(改为深窄23层×576隐藏),各指标全面提升,并以此作为消融研究基线(R0)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建立一个干净的scaling对照,作为该规模区间消融研究的基线,探究哪些改动能进一步改进模型。

Method: 方法固定(Qwen3风格解码器,GQA、RoPE、SwiGLU、RMSNorm、QK-Norm、z-loss;FineWeb-Edu数据),仅改几何为深窄23层×576隐藏;按梯度依次消融:值残差(R1)、Muon优化器(R2)、多样数据混合(R3)、两种logit蒸馏(R4a/R4b)。

Result: 扩容后BLiMP 78.1→81.3,ARC-Easy 51.4→52.5,WiKiText-2 BPP 2.04→1.95;81.3% BLiMP约等GPT-X2-125M(81.28)但参数少约12%,且训练token更少(8B vs 12B)。R1+R2累计提升ARC-Easy +3.6(52.5→56.1)且BLiMP基本不变;R3与R4未保留,蒸馏可达56.99但perplexity代价大。

Conclusion: 增益来自容量与深度而非数据。R1(值残差)与R2(Muon)为保留的最佳堆栈;R3、R4为诚实的负面结果。

Abstract: We scale our conventional sub-150M pretraining recipe from 53.5M to 109.7M parameters, holding the method fixed (Qwen3-style decoder with grouped-query attention, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm, QK-Norm, and a z-loss; FineWeb-Edu data) and changing only the geometry to a deep-and-thin 23-layer x 576-hidden design. The larger model improves across the board -- BLiMP 78.1 -> 81.3, ARC-Easy 51.4 -> 52.5, WikiText-2 byte-perplexity 2.04 -> 1.95 -- and its 81.3% BLiMP essentially matches GPT-X2-125M (81.28) at about 12% fewer parameters. Notably the 110M model achieves this on fewer training tokens (about 8B vs 12B), so the gain is attributable to capacity and depth, not more data. Both models are deliberately conventional; this report is a clean scaling control and the baseline rung (R0) of an ablation study of what further improves models in this regime. An ablation ladder follows: value residuals (R1) and the Muon optimizer (R2) lift ARC-Easy by a cumulative +3.6 (52.5 -> 56.1) at a near-flat BLiMP and are kept; a diverse data blend (R3) and two logit-distillation settings (R4a/R4b) are not kept -- honest negatives. R3 pins ARC-Easy to FineWeb-Edu's educational filtering rather than raw diversity; distillation from a 1.7B teacher can reach the class-leading ARC-Easy (56.99, matching GPT-X2-125M) but only at a perplexity cost that dialing KD down then erases -- so R2 remains the best kept stack.

</details>


### [407] [Moral Rebel Agents: Decision-Making Under Conflicting Obligations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14716)
*Hector Munoz-Avila,David W. Aha,Paola Rizzo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自主智能体的"道德反叛"——在执行分配任务时因道德理由偏离任务的能力，形式化并评估了五种智能体架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体通常须服从用户分配的任务，但严格服从可能与执行中出现的道德义务冲突，需要研究道德反叛机制。

Method: 形式化五种架构：无道德智能体、功利型、道义型、功利-道义(UD)型、尽责型；在分层任务网络(HTN)规划框架中实现，并在Mini Search-and-Rescue域中评估。

Result: 各智能体在救援结果、任务完成和规范遵从间呈现不同权衡；任务承诺的保持是道德反叛的重要维度，UD与尽责型虽共享功利与道义基础却行为显著不同。

Conclusion: 在道德相关环境中运行的自主智能体需要具备承诺感知的道德推理能力。

Abstract: Autonomous agents are typically obliged to follow user-assigned tasks. However, strict obedience may conflict with moral obligations that arise during execution. This paper investigates \textbf{moral rebellion}: the ability of an autonomous agent to deviate from a user-assigned task when morally justified.
