Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo matches or surpasses specialized methods with substantially fewer evaluations and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed existing state-of-the-art performance through flexible skill activation.

</details>


### [478] [LongAgent: History-Guided Agentic Search for Longitudinal Outcome Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15859)
*Siyao Wang,Florian Guitton,Shuojie Fu,Guanyu Tao,Kai Sun,Wenjia Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LongAgent，一种基于智能体的方法，自主搜索变量组合、时间窗口和纵向聚合函数，以从纵向医学数据中提取有预测价值的表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学纵向数据高度异质：变量众多、来源不同、采样时间间隔不一，且反映健康状态的不同方面。需要识别有预测价值的变量、处理纵向信息并整合多变量进行结局预测，现有方法难以自动完成这一搜索过程。

Method: LongAgent采用基于智能体的方法，能够自主搜索变量集合组合、时间窗口与纵向聚合函数，并利用先前搜索的历史记忆和数值证据来指导后续探索，从而识别具有良好预测性能的候选方案。

Result: 在合成数据上，LongAgent取得平均预测RMSE为1.7376，相比最强非智能体基线提升0.0151（95% CI: [0.0045,0.0260]；p=0.0273）。在真实临床数据集上，其表现与最佳基线相当。

Conclusion: LongAgent能够自动搜索纵向数据表征空间，在合成数据上显著优于最强基线，并在真实临床数据上达到与最佳基线相当的性能，展示了智能体方法在医学纵向预测中的可行性。

Abstract: Extracting informative representations from longitudinal data that can predict future outcomes remains a critical challenge in medicine. Medical datasets are inherently heterogeneous, consisting of a large number of variables collected from different sources, sampled with different temporal spacings, and representing different aspects of human health status. This requires identifying those variables with predictive value, processing longitudinal information, and integrating multiple variables for outcome prediction. Here, we propose a novel agent-based approach, LongAgent, that can autonomously search over combinations of variable sets, temporal windows and longitudinal aggregation functions, and identify candidates with promising predictive performance. LongAgent utilises a history memory of previous searches and numerical evidence to guide subsequent exploration. On synthetic data, LongAgent achieves a mean prediction RMSE of 1.7376 and improves over the strongest non-agent baseline by 0.0151 (95% CI: [0.0045,0.0260]; p=0.0273). On a real clinical dataset, it performs comparably to the best baseline.

</details>


### [479] [Pilot Early, Commit Late: A Real-Options Model of Enterprise AI Adoption under Rapid Technological Progress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15919)
*Gaurav Tewari*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文建立两期决策模型，研究企业在AI技术前沿快速演进、实施部分不可逆且组织能力需通过实践积累下的部署时机问题，权衡"立即部署、有限试点、等待"三种策略，并给出五项时机的核心结果及一项关于学习发生位置的比较结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI技术前沿快速提升、实施部分不可逆、组织专属能力只能通过行动积累，三者叠加使企业面临特殊的时机难题：过早部署可能遭遇架构过时，过晚部署则丧失当前运营价值与学习机会。现有讨论常把"部署"与"实验"混为一谈，作者希望明确区分这两种行为及等待的价值。

Method: 构建两期不确定性下的AI部署决策模型。企业在立即部署、有限试点、等待三者间选择：部署获得当期运营价值但承担架构过时风险；等待保留在前沿实现后再采用的期权；试点放弃当期运营价值以建立组织专属学习而不作完全承诺。另设连续时间扩展。

Result: 得到五项时机结果及一项学习地点比较结果：(1)均值保持的前沿不确定性上升提高等待与试点的价值，而当收益对前沿仿射时立即部署价值不变；(2)更快的预期前沿进步在架构只能捕获有限未来改进份额时，可能降低立即部署的相对吸引力；(3)当试点所建能力的期望价值超过其成本时，试点恰好优于等待；(4)足够有价值的组织专属学习产生"早试点、晚承诺"的最优区域；(5)存在闭式模块化阈值，超过该阈值时立即部署优于最佳外部选项；(6)生产学习与试点专属学习对时机边际影响不同。连续时间扩展重现了不确定性提高采用阈值、而能力与模块化降低阈值的标准结论。

Conclusion: 论文清晰区分了"部署、实验、等待"三种行为，说明快速技术进步可以理性地增加实验投入，但并不因此证明不可逆承诺是合理的。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence presents firms with an unusual timing problem. The technology frontier is improving rapidly, implementation is partly irreversible, and organization-specific capabilities are accumulated through action. This paper develops a two-period decision model of AI deployment under uncertainty in which a firm chooses among immediate deployment, a limited pilot, and waiting. Deployment earns current operating value but exposes the firm to architectural obsolescence; waiting preserves the option to adopt after the frontier is observed; a pilot sacrifices current operating value to build organization-specific learning without full commitment. The model yields five central timing results and a sixth comparative result on where learning occurs. First, a mean-preserving increase in frontier uncertainty raises the value of waiting and piloting but leaves immediate deployment unchanged when its payoff is affine in the frontier. Second, faster expected frontier progress can reduce the relative attractiveness of immediate deployment when deployed architecture captures only a limited share of future improvement. Third, a pilot dominates waiting exactly when the expected value of the capability it builds exceeds its cost. Fourth, sufficiently valuable organization-specific learning creates a nonempty region in which "pilot early, commit late" is optimal. Fifth, there is a closed-form modularity threshold above which immediate deployment dominates the best outside option. Sixth, production learning and pilot-specific learning affect the timing margin differently. A continuous-time extension recovers the standard result that uncertainty raises the adoption threshold while capability and modularity lower it. The paper separates deploying, experimenting, and waiting, and shows why rapid progress can rationally increase experimentation without justifying irreversible commitment.

</details>


### [480] [Recurrent GraphNeural NetworkswithSet-BasedAggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15932)
*Blai Bonet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究基于集合聚合的循环GNN，给出可从权重检验的充分条件，建立该类网络与模态μ演算片段BΣ°₁（可达性与安全性性质的布尔闭包）之间的双向有效等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的循环GNN逻辑刻画依赖多重集聚合、计数逻辑以及无法从网络参数验证的停机/接受条件，缺乏可验证性。

Method: 采用基于集合的聚合，识别可从权重检验的充分条件，使网络可编译为公式、公式可编译为网络，实现双向等价。

Result: 证明了一类网络与BΣ°₁片段（模态μ演算中可达性与安全性性质的布尔闭包）之间的有效双向等价；该片段恰为有限词汇表上稳定化的精确表达层级，支持单一极性不动点及其布尔组合，但不支持相反极性不动点的复合。

Conclusion: 该对应无需计数逻辑、外部停机信号或非有效接受条件，为满足条件的网络提供了从权重到符号解释的可验证路径。

Abstract: Recurrent GNNs iterate message passing to convergence, and their logical characterizations to date rely on multi-set aggregation, graded (counting) logics, and halting or acceptance conditions that cannot be verified from the network's parameters. We study recurrent GNNs with set-based aggregation and identify sufficient conditions checkable from the weights for networks to compile into formulas and formulas into networks. The main result is an effective, two-directional equivalence between a class of networks and the Boolean closure of reachability and safety properties, the fragment B$Σ^{\circ}_1$ of the modal $μ$-calculus. The fragment is not an artifact: it is the exact expressive level of stabilization over finite vocabulary, which supports fixed points of a single polarity and Boolean combinations thereof, but not the composition of fixed points of opposite polarities. The correspondence needs no counting logic, no external halting signal, and no non-effective acceptance condition, yielding a verifiable path from weights to symbolic explanations for networks meeting the conditions.

</details>


### [481] [Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15983)
*Honghao Lin,David P. Woodruff,Yuan Deng,Jieming Mao,Song Zuo,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Stellar Colosseum，一个模型无关的推理编排框架，用于跨长周期数学与理论计算机科学(TCS)研究问题分配推理，在TCS-Bench达71.0%，Codeforces解出222题中的218题，并解决FOCS/JMLR等顶会论文中的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型虽能生成简短可信的证明，但在长周期研究问题上仍不可靠——这类问题的进展依赖一连串不确定且相互依赖的决策，需要一种能在研究过程中有效分配推理资源的机制。

Method: Colosseum为模型无关的编排框架：在证明构造前先探索备选策略；用readiness gate判断路线是否成熟到可分解；将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题；把验证器发现路由回受影响部分。各阶段并行生成候选、用定向证伪攻击候选，并通过重叠随机采样树聚合将候选及其批评合并为单一研究产物。该工作流已作为Long Proof模式集成进Google Antigravity的Teamwork框架。

Result: 在开放研究与定理证明、竞赛编程基准上评估。使用Colosseum配合Gemini 3.1 Pro，解决了FOCS、JMLR等顶会论文提出的若干开放问题。在TCS-Bench（FOCS/STOC/SODA研究级定理证明任务）上，配合Gemini 3.1 Pro与Gemini 3.7 Flash达71.0%准确率；在Codeforces评测中，带执行反馈的证明导向流水线在222题中解出218题。

Conclusion: Colosseum证明了通过结构化编排（策略探索、就绪门控、子问题分解、验证回路由与并行聚合）可显著提升模型在长周期研究级数学与TCS问题上的可靠性，且方法模型无关，具备实际工程集成价值。

Abstract: Language models can produce plausible short proofs, but may still be unreliable on long-horizon research problems, where progress depends on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions. We introduce Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. Colosseum explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Across these stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The Colosseum workflow has also been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern.
  We demonstrate the capabilities of Colosseum through open-ended research and evaluations on theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks. Using Colosseum with Gemini 3.1 Pro, we obtain several new results that address open problems arising from papers published at top venues such as FOCS and JMLR. On TCS-Bench, a benchmark of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from papers published at FOCS, STOC, and SODA, Colosseum achieves 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. In a separate Codeforces evaluation using Gemini 3.1 Pro, the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solves 218 of 222 problems.

</details>


### [482] [Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15989)
*Keertana Chidambaram,Andrew Ilyas,Vasilis Syrgkanis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"plan injection"攻击：向actor模型上下文中注入有害但听起来无害的推理，可诱导其执行对抗行为同时规避监控，在多基准上实现25-33%的监控规避率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chain-of-thought监控被视为发现LLM不安全规划、欺骗或错位的安全策略。论文旨在揭示这种监控策略的脆弱性，即是否存在能同时诱导有害行为并规避监控的攻击方式。

Method: 提出"plan injection"：在actor的上下文中植入有害但伪装成良性的推理内容。先在Lanham等(2023)的多选题监控可评估设置中发现该攻击，使用Li等(2025)的investigator-agent诱导框架；随后将攻击推广到更难任务和更大模型（如DeepSeek-R1）。

Result: 攻击在不同监控可评估基准上达到25-33%的监控规避率，并成功扩展至更大模型。actor不仅执行注入的计划，还将其改写为自己的推理而不标注来源。额外监控资源反而有害：让监控者看到注入计划时，Bio-Math任务检测率下降高达50%；在推理预算案例中，额外思考token被用于合理化注入计划而非标记它。

Conclusion: CoT监控对plan injection攻击存在严重漏洞，且增加监控资源可能适得其反，凸显了当前思维链安全监控机制的脆弱性。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a safety strategy where the reasoning of a large language model "actor" is inspected by a "monitor" (often another language model) for signs of unsafe planning, deception, or misalignment. We find that planting harmful but benign-sounding reasoning in the actor's context can steer it to perform adversarial actions while evading monitors, an attack we term "plan injection". We initially discover this attack in the multiple-choice question-answering monitorability setting proposed by Lanham et al. (2023), using the investigator-agent elicitation framework of Li et al. (2025). We generalize the attack and show that the discovered behavior scales to harder tasks (achieving 25-33% monitor evasion rates across different monitorability benchmarks) and larger models such as DeepSeek-R1. Across the settings we study, actor models not only follow injected plans but also paraphrase them as their own reasoning, without explicit attribution to the injections. Finally, we find cases where extra monitor resources cause harm - giving the monitor access to the injected plan drops detection by as much as 50% in the Bio-Math task and in a case study on monitor reasoning budget, we find transcripts where additional thinking tokens are spent rationalizing the injected plan rather than flagging it.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [483] [BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13149)
*Aditya Karnam Gururaj Rao,Arjun Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BudgetBench：一个以每次调用输入 token 预算为自变量的主动预算评测协议与工具，用于对比记忆策略，并公开可复现实验工件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地大模型 agent 的主动上下文是稀缺资源：记忆容量、预填充延迟、缓存增长与服务目标都限制了单次调用的输入 token 数，但现有评测多固定单一预算，掩盖了预算合规失败与质量曲线非单调等问题。

Method: 在固定模型、任务、采样器与解码的前提下，扫描 2K/4K/8K/16K/32K 预算，记录质量、预算利用率、延迟及预算违规率。核心是提供可替换的 MemoryStrategy 契约、显式预算强制执行、确定/版本化评分器、提示审计元数据与可复现工件。

Result: 以试点研究（非最终排名）验证：本地 qwen2.5:1.5b 在 SWE-bench Verified 与 LongBench v2 各 89 项、托管的 50 项 Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench 复现、500 项 LongMemEval oracle 研究，暴露出预算合规失败、非单调质量曲线及单预算评测所隐藏的工作点。预算 vs 全上下文方向仍无定论，复现点估计偏向全上下文；早期试点的 tokenizer 近似低估部分 prompt，仅作为诊断而非结论。

Conclusion: 可复用的核心贡献是协议、工具链与失败报告纪律，以支持固定预算下记忆策略评测的规模化。

Abstract: For local large language model agents, active context is a scarce resource: memory capacity, prefill latency, cache growth, and service objectives all constrain how many input tokens each call can afford. We present BudgetBench, an active-budget protocol and reference harness that treats the per-call input-token budget as the independent variable when comparing memory strategies. Holding the model, task, sampler, and decoding fixed, it sweeps budgets over 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, and 32K tokens and records quality, budget utilization, latency, and, as a first-class outcome, budget-violation rates. The core contribution is this reusable measurement surface: a swappable MemoryStrategy contract, explicit budget enforcement, deterministic or versioned graders, prompt-audit metadata, and reproducibility artifacts, released at https://github.com/aviskaar/budgetbench.
  We substantiate the protocol with pilot studies rather than final rankings. Across a local qwen2.5:1.5b pilot (89 items each on SWE-bench Verified and LongBench v2), a hosted 50-item Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench replication with exact tokenization, and a 500-item LongMemEval oracle study scored by the official GPT-4o evaluator, the harness exposes budget-compliance failures, non-monotonic quality curves, and operating points that single-budget evaluation hides. The budgeted-versus-full-context direction remains unresolved: the local slice is near-null and the hosted replication favors full context in point estimate. We report results transparently, including that the early pilot's tokenizer approximation undercounts some served-model prompts, so its violation rows are tokenizer-approximation diagnostics, not claim-bearing results; all timings are operational diagnostics. The reusable contribution is the protocol, harness, and failure-reporting discipline needed to scale fixed-budget memory-strategy evaluation.

</details>


### [484] [A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13171)
*Koji Koyamada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨物理信息神经网络(PINNs)中"函数值拟合好不等于导数准确"的失效模式，并用一维基准测试加以验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINNs依赖自动微分施加微分方程残差，但函数值拟合良好并不必然意味着导数准确，这种"导数保真度"问题可能成为PINNs的隐性失效模式。

Method: 仅用函数值对sin(x)和exp(x)训练多层感知机，单独评估自动微分得到的二阶导数；并通过训练点密度、激活函数、边界密集评估以及L2和最大误差等多种诊断进行扩展测试。

Result: 结果显示，视觉上准确的函数逼近可以与显著更大的二阶导数误差共存，尤其在高曲率边界区域附近更为明显。

Conclusion: 该实验提供了一套诊断协议，用于区分函数值的准确性与物理残差的可靠性，揭示PINNs潜在的导数保真度失效问题。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use automatic differentiation to impose differential-equation residuals, but good agreement in function values does not necessarily imply accurate derivatives. This paper formulates derivative fidelity as a failure mode of PINNs and tests it with one-dimensional benchmarks. Multilayer perceptrons are trained only on function values for sin(x) and exp(x), while second derivatives obtained by automatic differentiation are evaluated separately. The hypothesis is strengthened by additional tests over training-point density, activation functions, endpoint-dense evaluation, and both L2 and maximum-error diagnostics. The results show that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors, especially near high-curvature boundary regions. The experiment provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.

</details>


### [485] [Land Art as a Big-Data Climate Sensor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13182)
*Alev Cinbarci,Sean Kalaycioglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文用1984–2025年1744幅Landsat/Sentinel-2影像芯片分析Spiral Jetty的复杂度特征，发现图像复杂度与湖泊水位及CO2相关，并领先湖面变化约三年。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Robert Smithson的《螺旋防波堤》随大盐湖水位涨落而显隐，常被当作气候变化的"温度计"。作者希望检验并超越"艺术即温度计"这一隐喻，验证小样本研究提出的熵与全球温度正相关是否成立。

Method: 对Landsat 4-9与Sentinel-2影像芯片进行配准，构建14维复杂度特征（Shannon熵、多尺度排列熵、分形维数、空隙度、GLCM纹理、强度统计及ResNet50特征）；并与NASA GISTEMP、USGS NWIS、Open-Meteo、Global Carbon Budget等42年气候水文数据对比，采用自助法、主成分分析、滞后相关、STL分解及偏相关分析。

Result: Shannon熵为弱代理，不支持其与全球温度正相关的旧结论；粗尺度排列熵与平均强度与湖面高度强相关（Spearman 0.85–0.88）。ResNet50嵌入第三主成分成为"AI气候轴"，与累计CO2相关0.86、与湖面高度相关-0.83。图像复杂度领先湖面约三年（滞后+3时Pearson r=0.58，CI 0.40–0.73）。STL显示非单调趋势，1984–2015上升后急剧下降。

Conclusion: 研究将"艺术即温度计"修正为"艺术即水文状态领先指标"，并公开数据集、特征流程与分析代码作为基准。

Abstract: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, has alternated between submergence and exposure during severe lake decline. We analyze 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and calendar month from 1984 to 2025. A 14-feature complexity signature combines Shannon entropy, multiscale permutation entropy, fractal dimension, lacunarity, gray-level co-occurrence texture, intensity statistics, and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 features. These measurements are compared with a 42-year monthly climate and hydrology panel from NASA GISTEMP, USGS NWIS, Open-Meteo, and the Global Carbon Budget. Bootstrap analysis shows that Shannon entropy is a weak proxy and does not support an earlier small-sample claim of positive correlation with global temperature. By contrast, coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity track lake elevation strongly, with Spearman correlations of 0.85 to 0.88 and 95 percent confidence intervals excluding zero. The third principal component of the ResNet50 embeddings emerges without supervision as an AI climate axis, correlating 0.86 with cumulative CO2 and -0.83 with lake elevation. Image complexity leads lake stage by about three years, with Pearson r = 0.58 at lag +3 and a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.40 to 0.73. STL decomposition reveals a non-monotonic trend that rises from 1984 to 2015 and declines sharply thereafter as the lake approaches record-low elevations. Partial correlations controlling for month and sensor confirm robustness to seasonal and sensor effects. These results refine the art-as-thermometer metaphor into an art-as-leading-indicator-of-hydrological-state interpretation. The dataset, feature pipeline, and analysis code are released as a public benchmark.

</details>


### [486] [LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13185)
*Mohammad Firas Sada,Dmitry Mishin,John Graham,Seungmin Kim,Mahidhar Tatineni,Frank Würthwein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文对比Complement Naive Bayes与零/少样本LLM（27B至1T）在文本分类上的表现，发现一旦有标注数据，NB在准确率、吞吐量与能耗上更具优势，并给出自动化模型选择工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回应LLM时代"是否应淘汰Naive Bayes等经典方法"的疑问，为资源受限的HPC从业者在文本分类中提供选型依据。

Method: 在多个文本分类任务上，对Complement NB与四个模型族、规模跨越37倍（27B到1T MoE）的零样本/少样本LLM进行基准测试，测量准确率、GPU/CPU吞吐量及单位样本能耗，并分析任务相关的数据规模阈值。

Result: LLM仅在零数据场景占优（Amazon Polarity 98.0% vs 88.2%），但存在污染风险，低污染任务NB反超（81.7% vs 73.0%）。有标注数据时（如AG News），NB达89.1%，与零样本27B LLM（89.0%）持平，优于397B前沿模型（84.8%），且CPU吞吐达数千样本/秒；小LLM批量推理比NB慢40–486倍，能耗约高两个数量级。

Conclusion: 对使用标注数据进行文本分类的资源受限HPC从业者，NB仍是最优选择；决策分界线依赖任务（主题分类约1万标签达LLM持平，零数据情感任务LLM始终占优），并提供基于Kubernetes Helm的自动模型选择算子。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) prompt a recurring question in research computing: should classical methods like Naive Bayes (NB) be retired? We benchmark Complement Naive Bayes against zero-shot and few-shot LLMs spanning four model families and a 37x range in scale (27B to a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts) across text classification tasks. LLMs dominate only in zero-data regimes (98.0% vs 88.2% on Amazon Polarity sentiment), and even that win is contamination-prone: on a low-contamination sentiment task NB beats the zero-shot LLM (81.7% vs 73.0%). However, once labeled data is available (e.g., AG News), NB reaches 89.1% accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from the zero-shot 27B LLM (89.0%) and better than the 397B frontier model (84.8%), at thousands of samples/sec on a commodity CPU. Fine-tuned DistilBERT reaches 90.6% but at far lower throughput than NB at batch size 1 (Table 2). Our measured GPU throughput analysis shows small-LLM batched inference is 40-486x slower than NB CPU inference (the multiplier depends strongly on the host CPU), exposing a structural gap bounded by memory bandwidth, with roughly two orders of magnitude lower energy per sample. For resource-constrained HPC practitioners performing text classification with labeled data, NB remains the optimal choice. We show the decision line is task-dependent (NB reaches LLM parity around $N \sim 10^4$ labels for topic classification, while zero-data sentiment favors the LLM at all N tested) and provide a Kubernetes Helm operator that automates model selection using configurable thresholds and verifiable Prometheus metrics.

</details>


### [487] [Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13191)
*Rabia Tüylek Tok,Burak Yağlıoğlu,Enes Dağ,Emre Onur Kahya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于学习的框架，利用连续CDM数据提前预测卫星交会碰撞概率（PoC），结合敏感性分析、PCA与TCN-Transformer混合模型提升LEO电推卫星的风险评估能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO中卫星与碎片增多导致近距离交会事件频发，尤其电推卫星低推力机动能力带来额外避碰时间约束；连续CDM因轨道不确定性非线性传播及PoC对协方差演化敏感而难以解读，亟需更早、更一致的风险评估。

Method: 先用无迹变换（UT）传播与反向传播评估碰撞风险对CDM参数的敏感性，再用PCA识别与PoC变化最相关的特征；据此筛选原始CDM参数并构造相对运动、交会几何与协方差不确定性等派生指标；用序列化增强交会数据集训练混合TCN-Transformer模型学习交会风险的时间演化。

Result: 框架应用于TÜBİTAK UZAY接收与分析的实际CDM数据，展示了其对LEO卫星交会更早、更一致运行风险评估的潜力。

Conclusion: 该方法通过敏感性分析、PCA特征构造与TCN-Transformer时序建模，可提前预测后续CDM的PoC，为LEO卫星（尤其电推卫星）交会风险评估提供了有效且一致的运行支持。

Abstract: The rapid expansion of operational satellites and orbital debris has increased the frequency of close approach events in low Earth orbit (LEO), creating a higher operational burden for satellite operators. This problem is especially critical for satellites using electric propulsion, where low-thrust maneuver capability imposes additional time constraints on collision avoidance planning. In current practice, Conjunction Data Messages (CDMs) provide relative state, covariance, miss distance, time of closest approach, and probability of collision (PoC) information for conjunction assessment. However, the nonlinear propagation of orbital uncertainties and the sensitivity of PoC to covariance evolution make the interpretation of sequential CDMs challenging. This study proposes a learning-based framework for early prediction of satellite conjunction risk by estimating the PoC expected in the subsequent CDM update of the same close approach event. In the proposed methodology, an Unscented Transform-based propagation and backpropagation framework is first used to evaluate the sensitivity of the collision risk metric to CDM parameters. In addition, Principal Component Analysis is applied to the numerical CDM parameters to identify the features most relevant to PoC variation. The results obtained from the sensitivity analysis and PCA are then used to justify the selected raw CDM parameters and to construct derived metrics representing relative motion, encounter geometry, and covariance-related uncertainty. Using the resulting sequential enriched conjunction dataset, a hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)-Transformer model is trained to learn the temporal evolution of conjunction risk. The framework is applied to CDMs received and analyzed within TÜBİTAK UZAY, demonstrating its potential for earlier and more consistent operational risk evaluation for LEO satellite conjunctions.

</details>


### [488] [Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13192)
*Feisal Alaswad,Batoul Aljaddouh,Maher Alrahhal,Wafaa Al Nassan,Talal Bonn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究比较传统机器学习模型与LLM生成规则系统在心脏病预测上的表现。传统模型（尤其Random Forest，准确率90.2%）持续优于LLM规则系统（Claude 80.3%，GPT-4o 70.5%），但LLM规则提供可解释的IF-THEN诊断逻辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨在医疗AI中预测性能与可解释性之间的权衡，评估LLM生成的规则系统能否作为传统机器学习模型的替代方案。

Method: 使用UCI心脏病数据集，对比Logistic Regression、KNN、SVM、Naive Bayes、Decision Tree、Random Forest等分类器，以及GPT-4o和Claude Sonnet 4.6生成的规则系统，采用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1-score评估性能。

Result: 传统模型整体更优：Random Forest最佳（准确率90.2%，精确率0.829，召回率1.0，F1 0.906），Naive Bayes次之（准确率88.5%，F1 0.881）。LLM规则模型较低：Claude Sonnet 4.6准确率80.3%（F1 0.833），GPT-4o准确率70.5%（F1 0.690）。

Conclusion: 传统机器学习在预测性能上优于LLM生成规则系统，但LLM规则具备更好的可解释性和透明度，体现了医疗AI系统中性能与可解释性之间的权衡。代码已开源。

Abstract: This study compares traditional machine learning models and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Several classifiers, including Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, were evaluated alongside rule-based systems generated using GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. Experimental results show that traditional machine learning models consistently outperform LLM-generated rule-based systems in predictive performance. Random Forest achieved the best overall performance with 90.2% accuracy, a precision of 0.829, perfect recall of 1.0, and an F1-score of 0.906. Naive Bayes followed closely with 88.5% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.881. In contrast, the LLM-generated rule models achieved lower performance, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaching 80.3% accuracy (F1-score: 0.833) and GPT-4o obtaining 70.5% accuracy (F1-score: 0.690). Despite the performance gap, the LLM-generated rules provide interpretable IF-THEN diagnostic logic that enhances explainability and transparency in clinical decision-making. These findings highlight the trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability in medical artificial intelligence systems. The complete implementation of all experiments, including machine learning models and LLM-derived rule classifiers, is publicly available in the GitHub repository at https://github.com/FeisalAlaswad/LLM-Rule-ML-Heart-Disease-Prediction .

</details>


### [489] [Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13194)
*Tesfay Zemuy Gebrekidan,Hadush Hailu Gebrerufael*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用从轨迹恢复的精确多项式不变量（规范化为Q上约化Gröbner基）检验"尊重物理结构能提升预测"这一前提，并转向将精确不变量用于故障诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量文献假设尊重底层物理的模型预测更好，本文要检验该前提是否成立，并探索精确不变量在何处真正有价值。

Method: 从轨迹恢复精确多项式不变量并规范化为Q上的约化Gröbner基；提出screening定位被违反的物理约束、attribution回溯错误不变量及责任物理参数；引入normal-form deflation与quotient-space recovery。

Result: 预测上精确性收益甚微：一致性正则降低代数残差但rollout保真度基本不变，100%质量误差系统恢复的势能加速效果与正确势能相当。诊断上15个注入故障中screening全部定位且无误报，attribution在7个参数故障中全部找回责任参数；基线无法定位。扰动1e-4仍保留14-15/15定位，而理想等式判定仅区分1e-12扰动。应用于350个发布对、11个RL环境，未发现模拟器动力学变化，反而揭示基准实现自身特性。

Conclusion: 精确规范不变量的价值不在预测而在诊断；定位而非检测是其主要优势，且筛选定位不依赖精确性，但代数比较需要精确性。

Abstract: A large literature builds physical structure into learned dynamics on the premise that models respecting the underlying physics predict better. We test that premise using exact polynomial invariants recovered from trajectories and canonicalised as reduced Gröbner bases over $\mathbb{Q}$. On Acrobot, exactness provides little benefit for prediction: a consistency regulariser reduces algebraic residual while leaving rollout fidelity essentially unchanged, and a shaping potential recovered from a system with a 100% mass error accelerates learning as effectively as the correct potential. Exact canonical invariants instead prove valuable for diagnosis. We develop two procedures: screening, which identifies the violated physical constraint, and attribution, which recovers the faulty invariant and identifies the responsible physical parameter. To enable this, we introduce normal-form deflation and quotient-space recovery. Across fifteen injected faults, screening localises every broken constraint with no false alarms, whereas observation-space baselines do not localise any; attribution recovers the responsible parameter on all seven parameter faults. Paired difference tests detect all faults, showing that the advantage is localisation rather than detection. Perturbing reference generators by $10^{-4}$ preserves 14--15/15 localisations, showing that screening does not require exactness, whereas ideal-equality decisions distinguish perturbations of only $10^{-12}$, showing that exactness is required for algebraic comparison. Applied to 350 release pairs across eleven RL environments, the diagnostic finds no evidence of changed simulator dynamics, instead revealing properties of the benchmark implementations themselves.

</details>


### [490] [Multi-Modal Tumor Survival Prediction via Graph-Guided Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14072)
*H Mathavan,H Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种图引导的专家混合(MoE)框架，用于多模态肿瘤生存预测，通过将现有模型作为工具自动调度集成，提升复杂任务预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽在少样本任务中表现优异，但在涉及多模态、多推理步骤的复杂现实任务（如基于临床数据、细胞切片、基因组学预测癌症患者生存期）中存在困难。现有方法因无法同时考虑所有模态、处理缺失模态、模态差异及多模态数据整合问题而性能受限。

Method: 受LLM尤其是MoE模型启发，提出图引导的MoE框架：利用图结构管理预测，结合多个模型增强预测能力。不训练单一基础模型做端到端预测，而是采用MoE引导的集成方法，将模型调用作为工具自动管理，通过MoE框架引导发挥各模型优势。

Result: 在TCGA-LUAD数据集上的实验与分析表明，所提方法相比单模态模型和普通集成模型取得了更好的性能。

Conclusion: 图引导MoE框架能有效整合多模态数据并自动调度模型，在复杂现实任务（如肿瘤生存预测）中实现更准确、更优的预测表现。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have displayed impressive capabilities in handling tasks that require few demonstration examples, making them effective few-shot learners. Despite their potential, LLMs face challenges when it comes to addressing complex real-world tasks that involve multiple modalities or reasoning steps. For example, predicting cancer patients' survival period based on clinical data, cell slides, and genomics poses significant logistical complexities. Although several approaches have been proposed to tackle these challenges, they often fall short in achieving promising performance due to their inability to consider all modalities simultaneously or account for missing modalities, variations in modalities, and the integration of multi-modal data, ultimately compromising their effectiveness. This thesis proposes a novel approach for multi-modal tumor survival prediction to address these limitations. Taking inspiration from recent advancements in LLMs, particularly Mixture of Experts (MoE)-based models, a graph-guided MoE framework is introduced. This framework utilizes a graph structure to manage the predictions effectively and combines multiple models to enhance predictive power. Rather than training a single foundation model for end-to-end survival prediction, the approach leverages a MOE-guided ensemble to manage model callings as tools automatically. By leveraging the strengths of existing models and guiding them through a MOE framework, the aim is to achieve better performance and more accurate predictions in complex real-world tasks. Experiments and analysis on the TCGA-LUAD dataset show improved performance over the individual modal and vanilla ensemble models.

</details>


### [491] [Machine Unlearning for Speech Question Answering in Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13195)
*Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次研究大型音频-语言模型(LALMs)在语音问答中的机器遗忘问题，提出并评估多种遗忘策略以移除隐私知识同时保留核心能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LALMs在语音理解与问答上表现强劲，但继承了大规模训练数据带来的隐私风险（敏感信息的意外记忆）。相比文本LLM或ASR，语音问答中声学感知与事实知识紧密耦合，使遗忘更具挑战。

Method: 提出并评估多种遗忘策略：梯度上升(gradient ascent)、任务算术(task arithmetic)，以及强制安全拒绝响应的对齐式微调方法。

Result: 在语音问答数据集上的大量实验表明，这些遗忘方法可将隐私泄露率降低多达80%，同时在非隐私语音问答与通用语音理解基准上保持近乎中性的性能。

Conclusion: 语音问答场景下的机器遗忘可在显著减少隐私泄露的同时基本不损害核心能力。

Abstract: Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in speech understanding and question answering (QA), but they also inherit privacy risks from large-scale training data, including the unintended memorization of sensitive information. In this work, we study machine unlearning for speech QA in LALMs, a setting that is more challenging than prior work on text-based Large Language Models (LLMs) or Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) due to the tight coupling between acoustic perception and factual knowledge. We present and evaluate multiple unlearning strategies, including gradient ascent, task arithmetic, and alignment-based fine-tuning methods that enforce safe refusal responses, to remove private knowledge while still preserving performance on core capabilities. Through extensive experiments on speech QA datasets, we show that these unlearning methods can reduce the privacy leakage rate by up to 80% while maintaining near-neutral performance on non-private speech QA and general speech understanding benchmarks.

</details>


### [492] [Algorithmic Information Dynamics of Learning: A Certified, Differentiable Complexity Controller for Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13197)
*Luan Ozelim,Hector Zenil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用可微分的认证复杂度的估计器K^CDM_sF替代分段常数的BDM，将算法信息动力学引入学习动力学，通过瞬时损失脉冲实现对grokking的控制与加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AID通过扰动系统并测量算法复杂度变化来研究系统，但常用估计器BDM是分段常数的，只能做有限差分，无法自然地进行微分演算，也难以在学习动力学（如grokking）中把复杂度序参量变成可主动作用的控制量。

Method: 采用certified且可微的估计器K^CDM_sF，将复杂度计算引入学习动力学；对训练施加瞬态损失kick，使估计器充当控制器，在Levin的描述长度-时间意义下加速grokking；通过消融实验对比复杂度门与训练损失门、检验认证先验与逐参数∇K归因的可替代性；对Occam场进行直接扰动以探测响应。

Result: 在数据依赖的Occam边界内加速grokking，其有限尺寸趋势f_c~ln p/p符合coupon-collector解释；复杂度门比训练损失门少用27%干预即可挽救失败种子；在测试信号中只有映射复杂度标记了转变完成；认证先验与∇K归因可互换（均匀先验传感器做出比特级相同的门决策，随机支撑在稀疏阈值上与∇K选择的支撑相当）；直接场扰动显示对Occam场呈类成核响应，无线性区，不能支持涨落-耗散代理；有限场响应在接近转变时增长数个量级，解释了经验调谐的bang-bang脉冲（停滞触发、屈服释放）。kick可迁移到稀疏奇偶与transformer，权重空间的持续损失则失败。

Conclusion: 算法估计器的独特贡献在于时机（何时触发、何时释放），而非归因。

Abstract: Algorithmic Information Dynamics (AID) studies systems by perturbing them and measuring changes in algorithmic complexity, but its usual estimator, the Block Decomposition Method, is piecewise constant, restricting the calculus to finite differences. We use $K^{\mathrm{CDM}}_{\mathrm{s}F}$, a certified, differentiable estimator, to bring the calculus into learning dynamics: grokking, where a complexity order parameter is known but has not been made to act. A\empts a transient loss kick, the estimator becomes a controller that accelerates grokking in Levin's description-length--versus-time sense, within a data-dependent Occam boundary whose finite-size trend, $f_c\sim\ln p/p$, is consistent with a coupon-collector interpretation. Ablations show that a complexity gate matches a train-loss gate in rescuing failing seeds with $27\%$ less intervention; among the tested signals, only map complexity marks the transition's completion; the certified prior and the per-parameter $\nabla K$ attribution are both fungible (a uniform-prior sensor makes bit-identical gate decisions, and random supports match $\nabla K$-selected ones above a sparsity threshold); and direct field perturbation shows a nucleation-like response to the Occam field (no linear regime is resolved over the probed amplitudes, so these measurements do not justify a fluctuation--dissipation surrogate), with a finite-field response growing by orders of magnitude toward the transition. These measurements account for the empirically tuned staircase: bang--bang pulses, stall-fired and released on yield, whose iteration plausibly builds the response it exploits. The kick transfers to sparse parity and to a transformer; a sustained weight-space loss fails. The algorithmic estimator's distinct contribution is timing (when to fire and when to release), not attribution.

</details>


### [493] [High-Probability Nash Regret for Decentralized Learning in Markov $α$-Potential Games: Episodic and Fully Online Asynchronous Algorithms with Applications to Markov Congestion Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.14959)
*S. Rasoul Etesami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究无限时域折扣马尔可夫博弈中纳什均衡的分散式学习，针对马尔可夫 α-势博弈提出KL投影自然策略梯度算法，在情景和完全在线异步两种设定下分别获得 Õ(T^{-1/4}) 和 Õ(T^{-2/15}) 的有限时间高概率NE regret界，消除了分布失配系数，并应用于独立资源马尔可夫拥塞博弈与在线作业调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有马尔可夫博弈中的NE学习研究在完全在线、异步、分散式场景下缺乏有限时间高概率保证，且regret界常含随状态空间增大的分布失配系数，估计预言机偏差与势近似误差也难处理。本文旨在去除这些限制。

Method: 提出KL投影自然策略梯度（NPG）算法，覆盖两种设定：（1）采样时冻结策略的情景设定；（2）玩家每步仅收到单次实现成本、沿持续轨迹异步更新的完全在线设定。进一步识别状态级势结构以得到对α有加法依赖的更紧界，并将框架应用于独立资源马尔可夫拥塞博弈（IMCG），构建基于实现成本的分散式估计预言机。

Result: 情景与完全在线设定分别达到 Õ(T^{-1/4}) 和 Õ(T^{-2/15}) 的有限时间高概率NE regret界（含固定近似项），成功消除分布失配系数，同时容纳势近似、估计预言机偏差与转移敏感性。状态级势结构给出对α加法依赖的更锐利保证。

Conclusion: 本文首次为马尔可夫α-势博弈中完全在线异步分散式学习提供有限时间高概率NE regret保证，去除分布失配系数，容许固定估计偏差，并为IMCG提供可扩展的有限时间分散式学习；同时应用于随机机器上的策略性在线作业调度，得到学习稳定调度策略的可扩展算法。

Abstract: We study decentralized learning of Nash equilibria (NE) in infinite-horizon discounted Markov games under bandit feedback, focusing on Markov $α$-potential games. We develop KL-projected natural policy gradient (NPG) algorithms in two settings: an episodic setting with frozen policies during sampling and a fully online setting in which players receive a single realized cost sample per time step and update their policies asynchronously along a continuing trajectory. We establish finite-time high-probability NE regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(T^{-1/4})$ and $\widetilde O(T^{-2/15})$ for the episodic and fully online settings, respectively, up to fixed approximation terms. Crucially, our bounds eliminate the distribution-mismatch coefficient, which can scale prohibitively with the size of the state space, while accommodating potential approximation, estimation-oracle bias, and transition sensitivity. We further identify a state-wise potential structure that yields sharper guarantees with additive dependence on the potential approximation error $α$. We specialize the framework to independent-resource Markov congestion games (IMCGs), establish their approximate-potential and transition-sensitivity properties, and construct decentralized estimation oracles from realized costs. As an application, we introduce strategic online job scheduling on stochastic machines and obtain a scalable decentralized algorithm for learning stable dispatching policies. Overall, our results provide the first finite-time high-probability NE regret guarantees for fully online asynchronous decentralized learning in Markov $α$-potential games, remove distribution-mismatch coefficients from the regret bounds, accommodate fixed estimation-oracle bias, and provide scalable decentralized learning with finite-time guarantees for IMCGs.

</details>


### [494] [SPICE: Simple Polysemantic Feature Interpretation via Clustering-based Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13198)
*Sehyun Lee,Dahee Kwon,Damin Lee,Jaesik Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPICE框架，用于通用化分析深度视觉架构中的多义性现象，避免架构依赖和人工设定聚类数K。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络可解释性中，单个神经元常被多个不相关概念激活（多义性），阻碍功能理解。现有方法依赖特定架构和人工启发式（如固定概念簇数K），通用性和可扩展性差，难以适用于现代Transformer模型。

Method: 提出SPICE（基于聚类的简单多义特征解释）框架，避免架构依赖的传播规则，可跨CNN和Transformer进行系统性比较，并自动确定每个神经元的概念簇数量，无需预设K，支持大模型可扩展分析。

Result: 实现了首个跨CNN和Transformer的多义性系统比较，并支持大规模模型分析。

Conclusion: 利用SPICE全面研究了多义性如何产生、随深度和架构如何变化，以及通过不同计算路径如何形成。

Abstract: One of the pivotal recent challenges in neural network interpretability is polysemanticity, where a single neuron is activated by multiple, often unrelated concepts, hindering clear functional understanding. Although prior work has explored this phenomenon, existing approaches remain architecture-specific and depend on manual heuristics such as a fixed number of concept clusters ($K$), limiting their generality and scalability--especially for modern Transformer-based models. To address these limitations, we introduce SPICE (\textbf{S}imple \textbf{P}olysemantic Feature \textbf{I}nterpretation via \textbf{C}lustering-based \textbf{E}xplanation), a generalizable framework for analyzing polysemanticity in deep vision architectures. SPICE avoids architecture-dependent propagation rules, enabling the first systematic comparison of polysemanticity across both CNNs and Transformers, and automatically determines the number of concept clusters per neuron, eliminating reliance on a preset $K$ and supporting scalable analysis for large models. Using SPICE, we conduct a comprehensive investigation into how polysemanticity emerges, varies across depth and architecture, and forms through distinct computational pathways.

</details>


### [495] [Discovering and Preserving Category Correlation Knowledge via Adaptive Reciprocal Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13199)
*Dawen Jiang,Zhishu Shen,Zeyu Liu,Tiehua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出自适应互惠知识蒸馏（AR-KD），通过对教师模型输出分布进行互惠适配，缓解师生差距带来的知识传递困难，在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 师生模型间的巨大容量差异阻碍了有效的知识传递。现有方法多采用静态单向的师到生蒸馏范式，忽视了学生学习的动态性，也无法对困难样本提供针对性指导。

Method: AR-KD对教师进行互惠适配：将教师的类别相关矩阵与学生的关系表示进行匹配，重塑教师的预测结构以契合学生能力。这种关系对齐缓解了过度自信教师导致的类间暗知识坍塌，使学生能学习到更丰富且更兼容的监督信号。

Result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-1k分类数据集上，AR-KD优于SOTA蒸馏基线。学生精度提升最高达7.13%，平均比vanilla KD高1.42%–4.15%，与其他先进方法结合时还能进一步提升。

Conclusion: AR-KD通过互惠适配教师输出分布，有效提升了同构与异构场景下的知识蒸馏效果，且具良好兼容性。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to improve the performance of lightweight student models by transferring knowledge from larger and more powerful teacher models. However, a substantial size gap between teacher and student models often impedes effective knowledge transfer. Most existing approaches adopt a static, one-way teacher-to-student distillation paradigm, which overlooks the dynamic nature of student learning and fails to provide targeted guidance on hard samples. In this paper, we propose adaptive reciprocal knowledge distillation (AR-KD), a novel method that improves knowledge transfer by simplifying the teacher's output distribution. Specifically, AR-KD performs reciprocal adaptation on the teacher by matching its class correlation matrix to the student's relational representation, which reshapes the teacher's prediction structure to better suit the student's capacity. This relational alignment mitigates the collapse of inter-class dark knowledge caused by overconfident teachers, enabling the student to learn from richer and more compatible supervisory signals. We evaluate AR-KD on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1k classification datasets, where it outperforms state-of-the-art knowledge distillation baselines. Specifically, AR-KD improves student performance across homogeneous and heterogeneous setups: up to 7.13% accuracy gain for students, 1.42% to 4.15% higher than vanilla KD on average, and further improvements when integrated with other advanced methods. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ARKD/.

</details>


### [496] [The Universe of Universes: Benefit Yield Functions, Implosion Thresholds, and Infrastructure-Aware Optimization in Multi-LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15314)
*Danielle Franklin,Vasu Raj Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Universes of Universes (UoU)框架，将LLM生态系统视为检索语料，定义边际收益函数BYF及崩塌阈值θ*。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM集成与混合代理系统只聚合输出，未研究随集成规模N的性能变化；基准研究只关注单模型平台期，模型崩溃文献只关注单模型分布退化，二者均未形式化集成层面的崩塌阈值，也未在生态层面建模知识遗传漂移或把AI生产速度作为θ*的协变量。

Method: 将主流LLM全生态系统视为结构化检索语料，构建组合式自动推理(AR)与机器学习(ML)架构，用于跨模型检索增强生成；形式化刻画Benefit Yield Function (BYF)，即每增加一个模型带来的边际性能增益，并识别崩塌阈值θ*——BYF穿越零点、聚合性能开始下降的集成规模。

Result: 定义了BYF与θ*两个核心量，并引入生态层面的Epistemic Hereditary Drift (EHD)与AI生产速度作为θ*协变量。

Conclusion: 该框架对国防部多模型AI采购政策及AI系统测试科学具有直接意义。

Abstract: We introduce the Universe of Universes (UoU) framework, which treats the full ecosystem of major large language models (LLMs) as a structured retrieval corpus and proposes a compositional Automated Reasoning (AR) and Machine Learning (ML) architecture for cross-model retrieval-augmented generation. The central contribution is the formal characterization of the Benefit Yield Function (BYF), the marginal performance gain per additional model added to an ensemble, and the identification of the implosion threshold θ*: the ensemble size at which BYF crosses zero and aggregate performance begins to degrade. Existing LLM ensemble and mixture-of-agents systems treat models as responders and aggregate outputs, but do not study performance as a function of ensemble size N across the full model universe. Benchmark research confirms performance plateaus at the individual model level; model collapse literature establishes that iterative training on AI-generated outputs degrades individual model distributions. Neither body of work formalizes the ensemble-level implosion threshold, models Epistemic Hereditary Drift (EHD) at the ecosystem level, or treats AI manufacturing velocity as a co-variable of θ*. The framework has direct implications for DoD multi-model AI acquisition policy and the emerging science of testing AI-enabled systems.

</details>


### [497] [Criticality in Dissimilar Decomposition and Undersampling of Random Datasets with Anomalies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13201)
*Ghurumuruhan Ganesan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究AI生成数据作为异常点混入训练集时，对随机数据集分解与欠采样性质的影响，利用冗余图和迭代技术推导强不相似（SD）分解最小规模的界，揭示了一个相变现象，并给出随机欠采样数据强相似性的规模临界结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来LLM的训练数据将包含大量由现有LLM生成的AI文本/图像数据，需理解这些AI生成数据如何影响批次分解及新LLM的性能。

Method: 将AI生成数据视为与主数据点"链接"的异常点，使用冗余图和迭代技术分析整体随机数据集的分解与欠采样性质，推导SD分解最小规模的界。

Result: 得到SD分解最小规模的界，展示相变现象：异常点少时最小规模由主数据点决定，超过某阈值后由异常点"接管"；建立了随机欠采样数据集强相似性的规模临界结果，并用类别数据集示例验证。

Conclusion: AI生成数据量存在阈值效应，超过该阈值会显著改变数据分解结构，对LLM训练数据的构造与欠采样策略具有指导意义。

Abstract: Training datasets for upcoming LLMs would include a significant amount of AI text/image data generated from current LLMs. In such a scenario, it is important to understand how this affects batch decompositions and thereby, the performance of the resultant new LLM. In this paper, we consider AI generated data as anomalies ``linked" to main data points and study decomposition and undersampling properties of the overall random dataset. We use redundancy graphs and iteration techniques to obtain bounds for the minimum size of a strongly dissimilar (SD) decomposition and demonstrate a phase transition phenomena, wherein the minimum size is essentially determined by the \emph{main} data points when the number of anomalies is small and is ``taken" over by the anomalies above a certain threshold. We also establish a size criticality result for the strong similarity of a randomly undersampled dataset and illustrate our results with examples involving categorical datasets, whose overall space size is much larger than the size of the dataset.

</details>


### [498] [Robust and Efficient Communication for Multi-Agent Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15361)
*Rafael Pina,Varuna De Silva,Corentin Artaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MARC框架，基于条件互信息原理，通过注意力架构与消息正则化机制，在多智能体强化学习中学习信息量大且鲁棒于物理约束的通信协议，在通信瓶颈与有损信道下显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式智能中，通信是关键，但现有MARL生成的消息既要信息丰富，又要能应对物理约束（如带宽瓶颈与有损信道），这一挑战尚未很好解决。

Method: 提出多智能体正则化通信（MARC）框架，受条件互信息的信息论原理启发；采用基于注意力的架构，并设计独特的消息正则化机制，通过最小化对未来系统状态的不确定性，诱导学习高代表性的通信协议。评估在严格通信瓶颈与有损信道下进行，模拟自主机器人网络与去中心化系统的现实约束。

Result: MARC在复杂协作任务中显著超越当前最优方法；对消息特性的深入分析表明，即使在大幅数据压缩下仍保持高运行性能，为资源受限环境中部署智能体提供了可扩展路径。

Conclusion: MARC通过信息论驱动的正则化通信，实现了在通信受限条件下高效、鲁棒的多智能体协作，具备在资源受限场景的部署潜力。

Abstract: Effective communication is a cornerstone of distributed intelligence in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), yet ensuring that generated messages are both informative and robust to physical constraints remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces Multi-Agent Regularized Communication (MARC), a novel framework inspired by information-theoretic principles of conditional mutual information. MARC employs an attention-based architecture coupled with a unique message regularization mechanism designed to minimize uncertainty regarding future system states, thereby inducing the learning of highly representative communication protocols. Crucially, we evaluate MARC under stringent communication bottlenecks and lossy channels, simulating the real-world constraints of autonomous robotic networks and decentralized systems. Our results demonstrate that MARC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in complex cooperative domains. Furthermore, we provide a deep analysis of message characteristics, proving that MARC maintains high operational performance even under significant data compression, offering a scalable path for deploying intelligent agents in resource-constrained environments.

</details>


### [499] [Do Tabular Foundation Models Still Need Feature Engineering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13202)
*Yifan WU,Pinjun Dong,Jiran Tao,Binyan Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究表格基础模型（TFM）兴起后，人工特征工程是否仍然重要。实验表明：特征工程收益集中在早期模型上，对最强模型几乎无效；但从相关数据集引入上下文信息仍能提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特征工程长期是表格机器学习的核心。随着在大规模表格数据集上预训练、通过上下文学习应用的表格基础模型（TFM）出现，一个自然问题是：当这些模型能力增强时，手工特征构建是否还有意义？

Method: 在两大 TFM 家族的多个版本上开展受控研究，在 TabArena 基准数据集上测试多种现有特征工程技术；并补充实验，考察从相关数据集引入上下文信息的效果。

Result: 特征工程收益集中在早期模型代际，对最强模型变得可忽略；而引入相关数据集的上下文信息仍能提升性能。

Conclusion: 更强 TFM 的性能提升来源发生转变：重新表征已有输入的效果下降，而提供额外任务相关上下文仍有价值。

Abstract: Feature engineering has long been a cornerstone of tabular machine learning. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained on a wide range of tabular datasets and applied via in-context learning. Their rise raises a natural question: does manual feature construction still matter as these models become more capable? To answer this, we perform a controlled study across several versions of two major TFM families, testing a wide range of existing feature engineering techniques on benchmark datasets from TabArena. We find a consistent pattern: feature engineering gains are concentrated in earlier model generations and become negligible for the strongest models. These results suggest that stronger TFMs depend less on explicitly engineered input representations. In a complementary experiment, however, adding in-context information from related datasets still improves performance. Our findings indicate a shift in the source of performance gains for stronger TFMs: re-representing existing inputs becomes less effective, while providing additional task-relevant context remains beneficial.

</details>


### [500] [Scalable partial information decomposition for symptom networks via supervised embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13203)
*Cillian Hourican,Eric Dignum,Rick Quax,Debraj Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出ePID（基于嵌入的偏信息分解）方法，将非焦点症状压缩为低基数离散嵌入以实现可扩展的两源PID，用于区分症状网络中冗余与协同信息。在PHQ-9上冗余主导（协同仅6–9%），而在IRI上45%的源对以协同为主。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 症状间的成对关系通常仅用标量边权表示，无法刻画两个症状是否携带关于第三个症状的重叠信息，或仅在组合中才出现的信息。偏信息分解（PID）能填补这一空白，但计算上超出少数几个源即不可行。

Method: 提出ePID流水线：将所有非焦点症状压缩为低基数离散嵌入，再计算可处理的两源PID，为每个有序源-目标对输出源独有、剩余独有、冗余和协同四个分量。在13种候选嵌入上做基准测试，包括合成贝叶斯网络（按PHQ-9校准）和83个真实数据集、五种PID度量。

Result: 监督式凝聚条件信息瓶颈（ACIB）嵌入在13种嵌入中恢复参考分解最准确，且在压缩四个及以上症状后对每种产生非负原子的PID度量均如此（协同恢复r=0.92）。PHQ-9网络（UK Biobank N=154,291；新乡学生样本 N=24,292）中，周围症状背景通过冗余和剩余独有通道承载大部分成对依赖，协同占6–9%，无向边以协同主导；而28项人际反应指针（IRI）中45%的源对以协同为主。

Conclusion: 通过分离重叠信息与交互依赖信息，ePID为标准的症状网络方法学提供了可扩展、与模型无关的补充，用以区分观察到的相关中的冗余与协同贡献。

Abstract: Pairwise relationships among mental-health symptoms are routinely summarised asscalar edge weights, which cannot express whether two symptoms carry overlapping information about a third or information that appears only in combination. Partial information decomposition (PID) addresses this gap but is computationally intractable beyond a few sources.
  We introduce embedding-based PID (ePID), a scalable pipeline that compresses all nonfocal symptoms into a low-cardinality discrete embedding and computes a tractable two-source PID, yielding source-unique, remainder-unique, redundant, and synergistic components for each ordered source-target pair. We benchmarked 13 candidate embeddings on synthetic Bayesian networks calibrated to PHQ-9 and on 83 real-world datasets across five PID measures.
  A supervised Agglomerative Conditional Information Bottleneck (ACIB) embedding recovered the reference decomposition most accurately of the 13 embeddings tested, and did so for every PID measure yielding non-negative atoms once four or more symptoms were compressed (synergy recovery r = 0.92). The two instruments then diverged sharply. In PHQ-9 networks (UK Biobank,N = 154,291; Xinxiang student sample, N = 24,292) the surrounding symptom context carried most pairwise dependence through redundant and remainder-unique channels; synergy contributed 6 to 9%, and no directed edge was synergy-dominated in either cohort. In the 28-item Interpersonal Reactivity Index, 45% of source pairs were. The identical pipeline, applied without parameter changes, therefore returned opposite profiles for the two instruments, each consistent with how that instrument was constructed.
  By separating overlapping from interaction-dependent information, ePID provides a scalable, model-agnostic complement to standard symptom-network methodology to distinguish redundant and synergistic contributions to observed correlations.

</details>


### [501] [GradRepair-ODE: Certified Gradient Repair for Neural ODE Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13204)
*Ziqian Bi,Xin Liang Chia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GradRepair-ODE，一个在优化器步进阶段检查、修复或拒绝 ODE 梯度的可靠性框架，为 ODE 梯度附加数值证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经 ODE 在训练循环中内嵌数值求解器，求解器同时决定前向轨迹和传给优化器的梯度。这种耦合带来可靠性隐患：在步长松弛、刚性动力学、混沌敏感或事件不连续情形下，可微 ODE 流程可能返回数值上可疑的有限梯度，而影响科学机器学习和连续时间生成建模（如扩散概率流 ODE、流匹配）的可靠性。

Method: GradRepair-ODE 在优化器步进处工作：计算多个梯度候选，用方向有限差分检验与求解器诊断进行比较，诊断可能的数值失效模式，通过路径切换或更严格重算修复选定的梯度，并拒绝无法认证下降方向的步。

Result: 在六个合成 ODE 系统上：低风险系统保持不变；Robertson 与 Lorenz 梯度被修复至与严格参考的余弦相似度 1.000；不安全接受步数从 37 降至 0；事件不连续情形被拒绝，而非施加未认证更新。

Conclusion: 论文主张对训练契约做简单修改：ODE 梯度应在附带数值证据的情况下到达优化器。

Abstract: Neural ordinary differential equations use numerical solvers inside the training loop. The solver determines the forward trajectory and also affects the gradient passed to the optimizer. That coupling creates a reliability problem for scientific machine learning and continuous-time generative modeling, including diffusion probability-flow ordinary differential equations and flow-matching models. Under loose step sizes, stiff dynamics, chaotic sensitivity, or event discontinuities, a differentiable ODE pipeline can return a finite gradient whose direction is numerically suspect. We introduce GradRepair-ODE, a reliability framework for checking, repairing, and rejecting ODE gradients at the optimizer step. The method computes several gradient candidates, compares them with directional finite-difference checks and solver diagnostics, diagnoses likely numerical failure modes, repairs selected gradients through path switching or stricter recomputation, and rejects steps whose descent direction cannot be certified. In six synthetic ODE systems, GradRepair-ODE leaves low-risk systems unchanged, repairs Robertson and Lorenz gradients to cosine similarity 1.000 against a strict reference, reduces unsafe accepted steps from 37 to 0, and rejects an event-discontinuous case instead of applying an uncertified update. The paper argues for a simple change in the training contract: an ODE gradient should reach the optimizer with numerical evidence attached.

</details>


### [502] [Task-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning for MoE-based Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13395)
*Tingqi Wang,Hongyu Ke,Haoxin Wang,Rafal Angryk,Zhipeng Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedTAR，一种任务感知的联邦微调方法，用于异构客户端数据下的MoE大模型，通过路由输出关联任务偏好，利用SVD提取任务坐标与更新方向，进行聚类内外聚合，保持专家专精并缓解冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构通过稀疏专家激活提升模型容量且限制计算开销，适合资源受限的分布式环境。但MoE大模型的联邦微调在客户端数据异构时面临挑战：不同客户端对应不同任务偏好，直接聚合本地更新会削弱专家专精，并在共享专家上引入冲突的更新方向。

Method: FedTAR通过路由输出建立本地更新与任务偏好的关联。对路由特征和本地更新分别应用SVD，提取低维任务坐标与更新方向。基于任务坐标，先在同任务偏好客户端间进行簇内聚合，再在不同任务组间进行簇间聚合。最后通过学习到的任务到更新映射重构聚合更新，确保最终更新与任务特定的优化方向对齐。

Result: 在四种基准任务、不同non-IID设置下评估，FedTAR持续优于强联邦微调基线，达到state-of-the-art性能。

Conclusion: FedTAR有效解决MoE大模型联邦微调中的异构数据问题，通过任务感知聚合保持专家专精、缓解破坏性干扰，取得领先性能。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a widely adopted architecture for Large Language Models (LLMs), as it improves model capacity while limiting computational overhead through sparse expert activation. This property makes MoE-based LLMs particularly attractive for resource-constrained distributed environments. However, federated fine-tuning of MoE-based LLMs remains challenging under heterogeneous client data. Since clients often correspond to different task preferences, directly aggregating their local updates may weaken expert specialization and introduce conflicting update directions on shared experts. To address these challenges, we propose FedTAR, a task-aware federated fine-tuning method for MoE-based LLMs. FedTAR establishes the association between local updates and task preference via routing outputs. Specifically, we apply Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to both routing features and local updates to extract low-dimensional task coordinates and update directions. Based on the task coordinates, FedTAR performs intra-cluster aggregation among clients with similar task preferences and inter-cluster aggregation across different task groups. The aggregated update is then reconstructed through the learned task-to-update mapping, ensuring that the final update remains aligned with task-specific optimization directions. In this way, FedTAR preserves expert specialization and mitigates destructive interference among heterogeneous clients. We evaluate FedTAR on four benchmark tasks under different non-IID settings. Experimental results demonstrate that FedTAR consistently outperforms strong federated fine-tuning baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [503] [Specification Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13415)
*Atticus Cull,Justin McCarthy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究语言模型能否作为紧凑的"活体规格说明预言机"：对比将事实存储于外部文本笔记还是模型权重。四类596事实世界、两种Qwen2.5规模下，权重型预言机更善于利用结构，但存储成本显著更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规格说明面临权衡：省略细节则关键问题无解，逐条记录则冗长庞大。作者探索用语言模型学习目标事实并直接回答，以作为紧凑的规格预言机。

Method: 对比两种事实存储方式：外部文本笔记 vs 修改模型权重（适配器）。在四类596事实的世界、两种Qwen2.5模型规模上进行实验，评估不同存储容量下的准确率。

Result: 7B模型下，权重型预言机在结构化世界中的跨容量综合准确率比非结构化世界高18.5个百分点，而笔记型仅高1.1个百分点。但权重方案存储成本高：最小适配器约175 KiB，远超笔记上限16 KiB。

Conclusion: 适配权重能更成功地利用潜在结构，而外部笔记所需的对象特定存储量显著更少。二者在结构利用能力与存储成本间形成权衡。

Abstract: Specifications face a basic tradeoff: leave details out, and important questions go unanswered; record every detail separately, and the specification becomes large and prolix. We investigate whether a language model can serve as a compact, living specification oracle by learning facts about a target and answering questions about it directly. We compare two ways of storing the learned facts: external text notes and changes to the model's weights. Across four families of 596-fact worlds and two Qwen2.5 model sizes, weight-only oracles benefited substantially more from structure: with the 7B model, their accuracy integrated across storage capacities was 18.5 percentage points higher on structured than unstructured worlds, compared with 1.1 points for note-sheet oracles. This advantage came at a substantial storage cost, with the smallest adapter requiring approximately 175 KiB compared with a maximum note budget of 16 KiB. Adapted weights therefore exploited latent structure more successfully, while external notes required substantially less object-specific storage.

</details>


### [504] [ReCAST: Reward Credit Assignment across Timesteps for Online Diffusion Reinforcement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13425)
*Yihang Chen,Yuanhao Ban,Kuei-Chun Kao,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReCAST，首个在扩散模型奖励微调中实现逐奖励、逐时间步信用分配的方法，通过区分用户偏好与奖励信息量，提升生成模型的对齐与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用多奖励训练扩散模型时需区分两个问题：用户偏好决定各奖励对总目标的贡献权重；奖励信息量决定其反馈在去噪过程中何时有效。有些奖励在全局结构刚出现时即可评估样本，有些则需样本接近干净时才具信息量。现有方法无法联合解决二者。

Method: ReCAST通过奖励×时间步权重矩阵W分离用户偏好与时间分配：行和匹配用户给定奖励预算λ，列和相等使每个去噪步总权重相同。在该边际约束下，按各奖励的信息量分配权重，用每步的Rényi可判别性增益量化，这些增益可累加为奖励诱导正策略与当前策略间的总可判别性，为时间信用分配提供依据。

Result: 在SD3.5-Medium上以两种不同四奖励设置、各五种奖励预算λ进行评测。ReCAST在一种设置中提升训练奖励，另一种中持平；在两种设置下均提升所有留出评判器表现，并被独立LLM-as-a-Judge偏好。

Conclusion: ReCAST产生的改进可泛化到训练奖励之外，支持其核心原则：在奖励反馈最具信息量的去噪时间步给予该奖励更大权重。

Abstract: Training diffusion models with multiple rewards requires distinguishing user preference from reward informativeness. User preference determines how much each reward should contribute to the overall objective; reward informativeness determines when its feedback is useful during denoising. Some rewards can meaningfully evaluate a sample as soon as global structure emerges, but others become informative only when the sample is nearly clean. To address both questions jointly, we propose ReCAST (Reward Credit ASsignment across T}imesteps), the first method, to our knowledge, for per-reward, timestep-dependent credit assignment in diffusion reward fine-tuning. ReCAST separates user preferences from temporal allocation through a reward-by-timestep weight matrix $W$, whose row sums match the user-specified reward budgets $λ$, while its column sums are equal, assigning the same total weight to each denoising step. Under these marginal constraints, ReCAST allocates weight according to each reward's informativeness, quantified by its Rényi discriminability gain at each step. These gains telescope to the total discriminability between the reward-induced positive policy and the current policy, providing a basis for temporal credit assignment. We evaluate ReCAST by training SD3.5-Medium under two distinct four-reward settings, each across five reward budgets $λ$. ReCAST improves the training rewards in one setting and matches them in the other, improves every held-out judge in both, and is preferred by an independent LLM-as-a-Judge. Together, these results show that ReCAST yields improvements that generalize beyond the training rewards and support its core principle: assigning each reward greater weight at the denoising timesteps where its feedback is most informative.

</details>


### [505] [Certifiably Interpretable Training of ReLU-MLPs for Boolean Tasks with Guaranteed Truth-Table Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13439)
*Hrad Ghoukasian,Anastasis Kratsios*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 MACCHIATO 训练算法，同时构造可解释的结构化 ReLU-MLP 及其布尔电路证明，并提供统计泛化保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着算力、模型和训练算法发展，AI 系统越来越强但其可解释性不断下降，亟需保障可解释性的方法。

Method: 迭代地将布尔函数残差投影到低维 {AND,OR,XOR} 电路类，并精确编译为 ReLU-MLP；结合电路编译、ESPRESSO 逻辑最小化和基于影响的变量选择。

Result: 在影响恢复条件下，若每个残差至多依赖 log2(B) 位，样本分裂算法用 T 个观测返回六层、宽度 O(mB) 的 ReLU-MLP，真值表误差 O(sqrt(m(B+log(m/δ))/T))；合成随机 junta 任务上部分稀疏或投影对齐场景优于 Adam-MLP，且 PyEDA 实现可在 ESPRESSO 超三小时预算的场景完成。

Conclusion: MACCHIATO 为可解释 AI 提供兼具显式电路证书与统计保证的训练途径，并在部分任务和计算效率上展现优势。

Abstract: As compute scales, models evolve, and training algorithms advance, our ability to explain the increasingly powerful AI systems they enable is eroding. To help safeguard interpretability, we introduce a specialized training algorithm (MACCHIATO) that jointly constructs (i) an explicitly structured $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP from partial truth-table observations and (ii) an explicit Boolean circuit over signed literals with $\{\operatorname{AND},\operatorname{OR},\operatorname{XOR}\}$ gates certifying what its subnetworks compute and how they compose. Intuitively, we iteratively project the residuals of a Boolean function onto low-dimensional $\{\operatorname{AND},\operatorname{OR},\operatorname{XOR}\}$-circuit classes and exactly compile the resulting circuit into a $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP; we combine $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP circuit compilation, ESPRESSO logic minimization, and influence-based variable selection.
  Roughly speaking, our interpretability certificate is complemented by a statistical guarantee: under the theorem's influence-recovery conditions, if each of the $m$ stage-wise residuals depends on at most $\log_2(B)$ bits, a sample-splitting variant of our algorithm trained on $T$ observations returns a six-layer $\operatorname{ReLU}$-MLP (counting the input layer) of width $\mathcal{O}(mB)$ with truth-table error $\mathcal{O}\bigl(\sqrt{m(B+\log(m/δ))/T}\bigr)$.
  On synthetic random-junta tasks, our networks outperform depth- and hidden-width-matched Adam-trained MLPs in several data-sparse or projection-aligned regimes, while the trained ReLU-MLPs are stronger in others. Moreover, in our explicit PyEDA truth-table implementation, the iterative procedure completes in regimes where flat ambient-dimensional ESPRESSO exceeds the three-hour computational budget.

</details>


### [506] [Efficient Online Inverse Optimization with $O(d)$ Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13440)
*Yang Cai,Anupam Gupta,Vineet Gupta,Guru Guruganesh,Yanchen Jiang,Christopher Liaw,Aranyak Mehta,Renato Paes Leme,Grigoris Velegkas,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个高效且"proper"的确定性在线逆线性优化算法，遗憾界为 O(d)，每轮耗时 O(d²)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前 Dewasurendra 虽得到 O(d) 遗憾界，但使用的是 improper 规则，需枚举所有尺度上的覆盖，每轮耗时 T^{Θ(d)}，效率极低。本文旨在获得首个高效且 proper 的 O(d) 界算法。

Method: 基于 Sakaue 等人的变度量（variable-metric）框架，引入自归一化秩一更新（self-normalized rank-one update），并用迹幂 tr(H^{-1/2}) 替代 log det 位势，该量本身有界，从而消除了 ln T 项。

Result: 算法达到 O(d) 遗憾界（对时间跨度一致），每轮 O(d²) 时间，首次实现高效且 proper 的界。该界对不优化的专家（non-optimizing expert）也成立，并给出抗腐败（corruption-robust）、秩自适应（rank-adaptive）变体以及在凸最小化中的应用。

Conclusion: 本文解决了 Gollapudi 等人及 Oki、Sakaue 提出的开放问题，给出首个高效、proper 的确定性在线逆线性优化算法，并扩展至鲁棒与自适应设定及凸优化应用。

Abstract: We give a deterministic algorithm for online inverse linear optimization with regret $O(d)$, uniform in the horizon and $O(d^{2})$ time per round. A bound of this order was obtained recently by Dewasurendra, settling a question of Gollapudi et al.\ and of Oki and Sakaue, but by an improper rule that enumerates covers at every scale and costs $T^{Θ(d)}$ a round; ours is the first efficient such bound and the first proper one. We build on the variable-metric framework of Sakaue et al., adding a self-normalized rank-one update, and we replace the $\log\det$ potential by the trace power $\tr(H^{-1/2})$, which is bounded outright and removes the $\ln T$. The bound also holds against an expert that does not optimize, and we give corruption-robust and rank-adaptive variants, and an application to convex minimization.

</details>


### [507] [Learning to Solve Hard Problems in RL for LLMs by Never Giving Up](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13443)
*Michael Noukhovitch,Hamish Ivison,Nathan Lambert,Aaron Courville*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RL训练LLM存在"马太效应"：易题提升大、难题提升小。提出NGU自适应采样方法，动态重分配计算资源，按计算提升性能，尤其在难题上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL对数据集中不同难度问题的提升不均衡，难题提升小。作者认为现代RL方法在易题上浪费过多计算，应动态重分配计算资源。

Method: 提出Never Give Up (NGU)自适应采样方法：为某问题持续生成样本直到得到正确答案；利用异步RL，自然减少易题采样并给难题分配更多计算；研究了off-policy鲁棒性等设计选择并总结最佳实践。

Result: 在数学基准Deepscaler上，NGU按计算提升性能，尤其在难题上；在Manufactoria编程任务上，标准GRPO难以完全解决问题，NGU迭代改进逐步解决越来越难的测试直至完全解决。

Conclusion: 通过自适应重分配计算资源，NGU缓解RL中的马太效应，提升性能与计算效率，尤其在困难任务上表现显著。

Abstract: We demonstrate that training LLMs with RL does not improve performance equally across a dataset. RL shows large improvements on easy problems that an LLM is already good at solving, but small improvements on hard problems. We call this the Matthew Effect in RL for LLMs, after the phenomenon of cumulative advantage from economics and network science summarized as "the rich get richer". The naive explanation is that hard problems require more compute to find a solution. We argue that modern RL methods are exacerbating the issue by wasting too much compute on easy problems and instead should dynamically reallocate how they use compute. We introduce Never Give Up (NGU), a simple adaptive sampling method that keeps generating samples for a problem until one is correct. By leveraging asynchronous RL, this naturally uses fewer samples to filter out easy problems and allocates more compute to solving harder problems. We investigate the design choices that affect NGU, such as off-policy robustness, and develop a set of best practices. On the math benchmark Deepscaler, NGU improves performance per compute, especially on harder problems. On a recent coding task, Manufactoria, standard GRPO with a per-test reward fails to fully solve problems that have a range of easy and difficult tests. NGU iteratively improves, solving harder and harder tests, until it learns to fully solve coding problems.

</details>


### [508] [A Machine Learning API for Earth Observation Data Cubes Based on openEO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13453)
*Brian Pondi,Jonas Hurst,Rolf Simoes,Jonas Starke,Marius Appel,Edzer Pebesma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出openEO的过程级机器学习(ML)规范，分模型初始化、模型操作、模型管理三阶段，支持随机森林、SVM及TempCNN等深度学习模型，并通过R/Python原型和作物类型制图用例验证跨后端互操作性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测(EO)数据以时空数据立方体组织，而ML方法作用于表格特征矩阵或结构化张量，二者不匹配导致需要平台特定的转换，难以在不同云基础设施间复现和迁移。openEO虽提供统一的EO数据访问与处理接口，但缺少标准化的ML集成方式。

Method: 提出openEO的过程级ML规范，分为三阶段：模型初始化、模型操作(训练、调参、推理、验证)、模型管理。支持经典算法(Random Forest、SVM)以及面向时间序列和空间块建模的深度学习架构(TempCNN、时序注意力编码器、基础模型推理)。实现三个R和Python原型以验证跨技术栈可行性。

Result: 作物类型制图用例通过向独立的R和Python后端提交相同过程图，比较预测结果与评估指标，展示了跨后端互操作性；另两个用例分别在专用后端展示时间序列深度学习和基础模型推理。但原型表明，完全跨后端可移植性需比过程级更深入的序列化格式与执行语义协调。

Conclusion: 后端库版本和规范边界之外的预处理约定会影响可复现性。关键近期方向是通过显式后端一致性配置文件解决这两方面问题。该规范提升了EO数据立方体上ML工作流跨云平台的可复现性、可移植性和可访问性。

Abstract: Earth Observation (EO) data are increasingly organized as spatio-temporal data cubes, while machine learning (ML) methods operate on tabular feature matrices or structured tensor inputs. This mismatch forces platform-specific transformations that are difficult to reproduce or transfer across cloud infrastructures. The openEO specification provides a unified interface for EO data access and processing across heterogeneous backends, but lacks a standardized approach for ML integration.
  We propose a process-level ML specification for openEO structured into three stages: model initialization, model actions (training, tuning, inference, validation), and model management. It supports classical algorithms such as Random Forest and SVM, as well as deep learning architectures for time-series and spatial patch-based modeling, including TempCNN, Temporal Attention Encoders, and foundation model inference. Three prototype implementations in R and Python demonstrate feasibility across diverse technology stacks. A crop type mapping use case demonstrates cross-backend interoperability by submitting an identical process graph to independent R and Python backends and comparing predictions and evaluation metrics.
  Two further use cases demonstrate deep learning on time series and foundation model inference, each executed on a dedicated backend. The prototypes reveal, however, that full cross-backend portability requires deeper harmonization of serialization formats and execution semantics than the process level alone can enforce; backend library versions and preprocessing conventions outside the specification's boundary also affect reproducibility. Addressing both through explicit backend conformance profiles represents the most important near-term direction. The specification advances the reproducibility, portability, and accessibility of ML workflows on EO data cubes across cloud platforms.

</details>


### [509] [On the Potential of Multi-Task Learning in Predictive Process Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13477)
*Lukas Kirchdorfer,Keyvan Amiri Elyasi,Heiner Stuckenschmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究多任务学习(MTL)在预测性流程监控(PPM)中的效果，评估多种任务组合、网络架构和优化方法，发现MTL对下一活动预测有显著提升并能缓解类别不平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPM中大多数深度学习方法采用单任务学习(STL)，即每个任务训练独立模型，导致维护成本高且忽视了任务间潜在协同。MTL虽有前景，但在PPM中效果未被充分探索：MTL是否及在何种设置下优于STL、哪些任务最受益、哪些任务组合最具协同性、任务如何平衡等问题尚不清楚。

Method: 作者开展了首个针对PPM的MTL综合性实证研究，评估了多种任务组合、多种神经网络架构以及多种优化方法。

Result: 结果显示MTL是PPM的一个强范式：在下一活动预测上取得显著提升，并能固有地缓解类别不平衡问题；任务平衡在低容量模型下尤为关键。

Conclusion: MTL可作为PPM的有效范式，兼顾预测性能提升与类别不平衡缓解，但需根据模型容量谨慎设计任务平衡策略。

Abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts how ongoing organizational processes unfold, enabling information systems to move beyond execution support toward proactive analysis and monitoring. Although deep learning has improved prediction accuracy in PPM, most approaches follow a single-task learning (STL) setup, training a separate model per task. This increases maintenance effort and overlooks potential synergies. Multi-task learning (MTL), which jointly learns multiple prediction targets in one model, offers a promising alternative, yet its effectiveness in PPM remains underexplored. It remains unclear whether and under which settings MTL improves upon STL, which prediction tasks benefit most from joint learning, which task combinations are particularly synergistic, and if and how tasks should be balanced. To fill this gap, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of MTL for PPM, evaluating a variety of task combinations, neural architectures, and optimization methods. Overall, our results position MTL as a strong paradigm for PPM: we see substantial improvements in next-activity prediction and inherent mitigation of class imbalance using MTL, while task balancing is especially critical under low-capacity models.

</details>


### [510] [One Spectrum, Two Resources: Data-Memory Scaling in Autoregressive Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13500)
*Chiwun Yang,Xiaoyu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在正熵自回归检索源中提出预测能量谱，统一刻画数据与记忆两种资源，并证明极小极大律，实验验证数据-记忆坍缩与耦合指数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回答"需要多少学习记忆才能从更多数据中获益"这一问题，揭示数据与记忆两种资源如何被同一预测能量谱控制。

Method: 定义预测能量谱μ（查询概率×未知logit平方半径），证明极小极大律 R*≈Φ_μ(n^{-1})+Φ_μ(τ_B)，其中数据设定分辨率1/n、记忆设定最优位分配达到的层级τ_B；用掩码query-key注意力头实现路径与数值，并给出指数自适应分配、有限精度实现与计算精度律。

Result: 完整曲线可恢复正谱；能量-维度配对不可分割（具有相同块能量与块维度边缘的两个因果源数据与记忆指数不同）；实验重现数据-记忆坍缩与耦合指数，解释路由与分配机制，并在六个预训练模型规模上检验仅权重量化。

Conclusion: 数据与记忆由同一预测能量谱统一支配，存在数据-记忆权衡律，且能量与维度必须配对才能刻画资源指数。

Abstract: How much learned memory is needed to benefit from more data? We show that the two resources are governed by one predictive-energy spectrum in a positive-entropy autoregressive retrieval source. Each coordinate contributes its query probability times the squared radius of its unknown logit. Writing $μ$ for the resulting energy spectrum, we prove the minimax law $\mathfrak R^*_{\rm value}(n,B)\asymp_R Φ_μ(n^{-1})+Φ_μ(τ_B), Φ_μ(t)=\int\min\{x,t\}\,μ(\mathrm dx),$ for $n$ prediction blocks and a learned state with at most $2^B$ values. Data set the resolution $1/n$; memory sets the level $τ_B$ reached by optimal bit allocation. The complete curve also recovers the positive spectrum. Energy-dimension pairing is essential: two causal sources with identical block-energy and block-dimension marginals have different data and memory exponents. A masked query-key attention head learns the route and values, realizing the law with explicit routing, format, and arithmetic errors. Further results give exponent-adaptive allocation, finite-precision realization, and compute-precision laws under two-sided arithmetic assumptions. Experiments recover the data-memory collapse and coupling exponents, explain the routing and allocation mechanisms, and examine weight-only quantization across six pretrained-model scales.

</details>


### [511] [Pretraining for Sample-Efficient Neural Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13507)
*Ben Tang,Zachary Spalding,Gregory B. Cogan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAPA是一种带空间编码的掩码自编码器，可在异质iEEG记录上自监督预训练，实现跨受试者、跨任务的神经表征迁移，刷新Neuroprobe基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练高性能神经解码器通常需为每个新受试者采集大量标注数据。自监督预训练可减少标注成本，但对iEEG而言，受试者间电极植入位置和神经解剖差异导致自监督学习困难。

Method: 提出MAPA：一个本质为普通掩码自编码器的模型，加入两种空间编码——解剖区域嵌入（anatomical region embedding）和相对位置编码（relative positional encoding），使学到的神经表征可迁移到未见受试者和不同任务。

Result: 在Neuroprobe基准的三种设定（同session、跨session、跨受试者）下均无微调即取得最新最优。跨受试者设定中，MAPA特征的线性探针仅需约164个标注试次即可达到无预训练时需3500个试次的精度。

Conclusion: 自监督预训练可跨异质iEEG记录扩展，并减少新受试者准确解码所需的标注数据量。

Abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) decode neural activity to restore lost function. Typically, training a high-performance neural decoder requires a large labeled dataset to be collected from every new subject. One way to reduce the labeled data cost is self-supervised pretraining, which learns general neural representations from unlabeled recordings that accumulate across subjects. However, for intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) recordings, self-supervised learning has been challenging due to differences in contact placement and neuroanatomy between subjects. We propose MAPA, an otherwise vanilla masked autoencoder with two spatial encodings, an anatomical region embedding and a relative positional encoding, which together enable it to learn neural representations that transfer to unseen subjects and across various tasks. MAPA sets a new state of the art across all three regimes of the Neuroprobe benchmark without fine-tuning: within-session, cross-session, and cross-subject. In the cross-subject regime, a linear probe on MAPA's features needs only ${\sim}164$ labeled trials to reach the accuracy that takes 3,500 without pretraining. Our results show that self-supervised pretraining can scale across heterogeneous iEEG recordings and reduce the labeled data needed for accurate decoding in new subjects.

</details>


### [512] [A Three-Axis Stress Test of LLM vs Classical ML for Network Intrusion Detection under Distribution Shift and Adversarial Evasion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.13511)
*Muhammad Ebad Atif,Muhammad Haider Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过同数据集、跨数据集迁移和对抗规避三个维度对比XGBoost与RoBERTa-LoRA在NIDS中的表现，发现没有通用赢家，评估结论完全取决于测试维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM用于网络入侵检测（NIDS）的评测几乎都采用同数据集评估，这种评测范式不完整，无法反映模型在真实分布变化和对抗环境下的鲁棒性差异。

Method: 在两个独立采集的NetFlow v2网络数据上，对XGBoost与RoBERTa-LoRA沿三条轴进行评测：同数据集性能、跨数据集迁移、对抗规避；并进行分阶段特征泄漏消融实验。

Result: 同数据集上两模型统计上持平；跨数据集分布偏移下XGBoost以F1高15点、平衡准确率高25点显著胜出，RoBERTa-LoRA在目标网络上FPR高达0.78；对抗规避下RoBERTa-LoRA以约17点F1显著胜出，二者FPR均低于0.01。特征泄漏消融对跨数据集迁移呈非单调改善，说明泄漏信号分布于整个特征表示；跨数据集迁移具有强方向性。

Conclusion: NIDS模型评估应沿多个独立鲁棒性维度进行，且每个维度需使用多个指标，而非仅依赖同数据集准确率。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly benchmarked against classical machine learning for network intrusion detection (NIDS), almost always using same-dataset evaluation, and that protocol turns out to be incomplete. Evaluating XGBoost and RoBERTa-LoRA on two independently collected NetFlow v2 networks across three axes (same-dataset performance, cross-dataset transfer, and adversarial evasion) reveals no universal winner. The two models are statistically tied same-dataset. XGBoost wins decisively under cross-dataset distribution shift, by 15 points of F1 and 25 points of balanced accuracy; on the target network RoBERTa-LoRA's false positive rate reaches 0.78, leaving it barely above chance despite a superficially moderate F1. RoBERTa-LoRA wins decisively under adversarial evasion, by roughly 17 points of F1 at a representative mid-range perturbation strength, while both models hold false positive rates below 0.01 throughout. The model an evaluator would recommend therefore depends entirely on which axis is tested, not on same-dataset accuracy alone. A staged feature-leakage ablation improves cross-dataset transfer non-monotonically, indicating the leakage signal is distributed across the feature representation rather than confined to a few columns, and cross-dataset transfer between our two networks is strongly directional.
